Overall, we had a fair stay.

reviews.text:
We stayed in Muhammet's place for 5 nights, the place was as pictured abd very well kept. The apartment was very clean when we arrived and had all the amenities we needed. The neighborhood was quiet and nice to walk through. It is an old and central part of Istanbul, so expect narrow walk ways and streets, but that also means easy access to all metro lines and ferries. We booked a bosphorous cruise tour while staying here and it was only 15 mins walk to the cruise pick up point.
We also walked to Balat several times while staying here, it was only 20 mins walk. The path to Balat was very nice as you get to walk along the harbor and experience the true Istanbul.
Muhammet was a great host, he was very proactive about check in instructions and everything we might need while staying at his place. He was extremely responsive and polite. He was very nice to let us do a later check out than the normal times short time rentals or hotels allow you. It was a very kind gesture.

Muhammat is a great host and the place was clean and looked just like the pictures. It was quiet and a safe neighborhood. The Wednesday market turned out not to be an issue as the driver that Muhammat recommended picked us up down the block. WiFi and TV worked excellent and so did the washing machine

We had a great week in Istanbul staying at this apartment. We chose it for the well equipped kitchen and comfortable sitting room for the four of us to enjoy evenings in.
It has great bathrooms and showers and was clean and quiet.
We walked everywhere in the city (including walking all the home from Taksim Square, for example) as well as using the trams and metro. The apartment is about 30 minute walk to Aksaray on the T1 tramline.
Muhammet responded to question immediately including offering suggestions for things to do and where to eat when asked. We had a recommendation of an airport transfer from him as well.
There could be more information in the house manual which would have saved us asking some questions

We had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! The apartment was very nice, clean, and perfect for families. The host Muhammet was excellent at communicating and was quick to help resolve any issues that came up during our stay. The location can be a little hectic at times, especially because of the Wednesday bazaars. We also experienced construction directly underneath our apartment for a few days during our stay, but the host handled everything very well and stayed in great communication with us. One thing to keep in mind is that there is no elevator, and the apartment is on the second-to-last floor, which may be difficult for some guests, especially with luggage.
Overall, we really enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place!

Muhammet's place was exactly how the listing describes it. The apartment was clean and tidy when we arrived and we had a very comfortable 2 week stay. Muhammet's a very good, responsive host and a highly recommended staying at his apartment.

description: Welcome to your exclusive Üsküdar Duplex Retreat—a beautifully designed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment spread over two floors, combining comfort, privacy, and stunning Bosphorus views.

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our stay in this apartment. It has a beautiful view of the Bosphorus, and it's great that the living room and kitchen have a view. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. We were given clear instructions and were given extra time during checkout. Communication with the owner was very pleasant, and our messages were responded to quickly.
The metro and ferry station are nearby.
On the downside, seagulls live on the roof and scream loudly all day. It's impossible to sleep with the windows open, and there's no air conditioning in the bedroom. A floor fan helped, but it won't be enough in the summer. The roof gets hot during the day, and even the air conditioning doesn't help because it doesn't cool. The building is on a hill, but this is Istanbul, and that's the case everywhere. There's no elevator, and the stairs are quite steep, which might not be suitable for everyone.
Despite these minor downsides, we had a wonderful time and enjoyed the best view.

This is a fantastic apartment: two bedrooms, two bathrooms, two lounges, two floors. Almost two small apartments separated by a staircase, just one of them doesn't have a kitchen. And the view! Spectacular. Finally location: it is a five minute walk (climb, actually, lots of stairs) from the Uskudar ferry terminal. This has frequent direct service to Eminonu, Besiktas, and Cabitas, along with less frequent service to many other spots. You are a five minute walk and 20 minute ferry ride from Eminonu! Bus to Kadikoy is easy as well. Fantastic location. And the hosts were extremely responsive. When I am next in Istanbul I will look to stay here again.

Positives: Amazing views of the Bosporus sea. Outdoor Balcony. Nice Kitchen. 2 floors. Excellent for family who is fit and healthy as walk up hill is worth the daily views. Near historical mosque and 5 min from main ferries. Uskadar is family friendly. Go to LIMON for good food.
*Caveats: not for older people or those with physical issues as the walk to the apartment and floor is steep unless you are healthy. Top floor bathroom has bad smell and door needs to be closed at all times otherwise smell goes into bedroom. We learned to live with it for the view. No fix for this issue.

description: This charming hotel apartment offers a unique blend of simplicity and elegance with its modern, refined design. Perfect for two people or a couple, it includes a comfortable double bed, a well-equipped kitchenette, a private bathroom, and a 40-inch smart TV. Large windows . Ideally located just steps from Ortaköy Coast, Bosphorus Bridge, famous kumpir and waffle shops, and the historic heart of Ortaköy in central Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The hotel was very well located, just 3 minutes on foot from markets, restaurants of all kinds, and close to the ferry that connects to the whole city. Sometimes at night it can be a bit noisy for sleeping, but nothing that would cause a major disturbance.
The place is extremely clean, everything is new, but a bit smaller than it appears in the photos. Communication was always immediate, definitely a great spot to rest after a day of walking around the city.

Konum çok kolaydı. Tüm merkezi alanlara ve ulaşım araçlarına yakındı.
Havlular, yatak çarşafları, banyo temizdi.
Ev sahibinin iletişimi de iyiydi sorulara hızla yanıt verdi.

Absolutely loved this place! 😍 The room was beautiful, super clean, and well organized 👌
The staff were amazing—very professional and genuinely friendly.
The location is perfect and felt extremely safe, which made the whole stay even more comfortable 🙌
Such a great experience overall—I can’t wait to come back again! 👍

Our stay here was excellent!! The location is close to so many delicious restaurants and cafes. It’s very easy to get to different attractions around Istanbul. Parva was lovely and super responsive, checking in on what we need daily and provide recommendations on places to we should see.
The bed was extremely comfy and the aircon also worked really well. If we come back to Istanbul, we will definitely stay here!

Very nice place. Hosts are responsive and helpful. Location is in great balance, Ortaköy Bosphorus side is in 5 mins walking and area is full of cafes. Even though apartment is right behind food street, it’s calm. Good option for couples. Recommend!

description:
Discover the charm of this modern one-bedroom apartment in the heart of Beyoğlu. Perfectly located within walking distance of lively Taksim, this apartment offers a cozy retreat Whether you’re here for leisure or work, this serene space provides everything you need.

We prioritize accuracy for our guests. The listed square meters and layouts are exact, with no surprises. While views and some furniture details may vary, every apartment offers the same comfort for an equally enjoyable stay.

reviews.text:
Fantastic host.
Be aware that the shop downstairs charges dramatically inflated prices compared with shops immediately outside the building. Same goes for the pizza shop at the bulding called Deli Slice.
I stayed at this apartment. It was very close to everywhere we wanted to go and it was located in good location in Istanbul. Apartment was clean has everything we needed.

Great place for the money. If a gym and general comfort is important to you, this place exceeds expectations though it’s not the most convenient location. It is about a 20 minute walk to Galetta Tower, the closest neighborhood of note.
Super expérience. Appartement mieux que sur les photos. Très Cozy et fonctionnel. Je recommande
Ev beklentilerimi karşıladı temizliğe önem verilmişti ve merkezi bir yerdeydi tavsiye ederim

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text:
The apartment is very well located, which was definitely the biggest advantage for what we wanted to visit. The check-in process and lock system were also straightforward and easy to use.
The apartment itself is spacious, clean, and nicely decorated. However, we did encounter a few issues during our stay. On the first evening, there was no hot water in the shower, although this was resolved after contacting the owner. The bed was quite uncomfortable and made a lot of noise with even slight movement, which affected our sleep. Additionally, the bathroom unexpectedly smelled of cigarette smoke, possibly coming from the ventilation system.
We also found food left in the fridge, which we consider unhygienic. While the price we paid was relatively low, the apartment could benefit from some renovation—particularly the shower, which appeared old and had noticeable mold around the edges, and some walls that looked worn.
Overall, we appreciate the host’s responsiveness and thank them for havi

The apartment is fantastic, just like in the pictures — very spacious, bright, and comfortable. Its location is excellent, just a short walk from the Galata Tower and near the tram that connects all major tourist spots, making it super convenient for exploring the city. The neighborhood is charming and lively, with plenty of cafes, shops, and local character. Right next to the apartment is a small mosque, and while the call to prayer at 5 a.m. did wake us up a few times, it was minor and didn’t affect our stay much. The rooftop is amazing, with a stunning view over the city — perfect for relaxing. The host is super friendly, responsive, and very helpful. Overall, a great place to stay!

We stayed here for just one night during a transit. The location was very convenient, with easy access to public transport and shops. The apartment was exactly as described. It was spacious enough for our family of four (our children are 8 and 4). The host was very responsive and answered all of our questions promptly.

it took some getting used to the small alleys of Galata - but after figuring out, we realised the location was really well located - walking distance from Karakoy. The apartments were very clean. Only suggestion would be to add dish cleaning liquid and sponges - otherwise really well equipped. The owner is very responsive - as is the person handling the W/A.

Mükemmel Bir Konaklama Deneyimi! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐Galata ve Galataport’a çok yakın, harika bir konumda yer alan bu tesiste kalmaktan son derece memnun kaldık. Kaldığımız 1+1 daire tek kelimeyle tertemizdi ve ihtiyacımız olan her şey mevcuttu.Özellikle terasın manzarasına kelimenin tam anlamıyla bayıldık; muhteşem bir İstanbul manzarası eşliğinde vakit geçirmek harikaydı. Tramvay durağına ve toplu taşıma araçlarına çok yakın olması da ulaşımımızı inanılmaz kolaylaştırdı.Bizi karşılayan ekip ise çok nazik, güler yüzlü ve yardımseverdi. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettirdiler. Hem konumuyla hem de sunduğu konforla kesinlikle tekrar tercih edeceğimiz bir yer. Her şey için çok teşekkür ederiz, herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim!

description:
Discover the charm of Old Istanbul in our stylish apartment located in the heart of Fatih, Silivrikapı district! Located in a new building, this modern retreat combines contemporary comfort with the charm of Istanbul's rich history. The apartment offers a cozy, stylish ambiance with a fully glazed shower cabin and tasteful decor for a truly refreshing experience.

Book to enjoy Istanbul with easy access in an iconic, historic setting!

reviews.text: Mekan, turist olarak ihtiyacınız olan hemen hemen her şey bulabileceğiniz harika bir konuma sahiptir. Mekan fotoğraflardaki gibidir. Listelenen bütün olanaklar mevcuttu. Her şey çok temizdi ve ev sahibi oldukça ilgiliydi ve mesajlarıma çok kısa süre içerisinde yanıt verdi. Giriş yaptıktan sonra her şeyin eksiksiz olduğunu sormak için tekrardan iletişime geçti ve nazik bir üsluba sahipti. Tekrardan İstanbul’a geldiğimde tercih edeceğim bir yer oldu. Gönül rahatlığıyla konaklayabilirsiniz :)
I had a wonderful stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the listing. The host was very responsive and friendly. Check-in was smooth. Would definitely stay here again.
A very nice and responsive host. The apartment is just as described and very clean. The area is quiet and the room darkening curtains were fabulous. Bed is comfy and I felt right at home.

The appartment was as it was described! Plenty of room, nice design! The host was very helpful with excellent recommendations of restaurants!! The neighborhood is a classical turkish family neighbourhood with too many supermarkets nearby!

Her şey fotoğraflarda ve açıklamalarda belirtildiği gibiydi. İhtiyaçlarımıza hızlı dönüş sağlandı. Sadece park konusunda biraz sıkıntı yaşadım. Onun için de yakın bölgede belediye otoparkı mevcut. Güzel ve keyifli bir konaklamaydı. Teşekkür ederim 🙏

description:
In the center of Istanbul, in the heart of Beyoğlu, 1 minute away from Galata Tower
Our apartment, which is 2 minutes away from the metro and bus stops, is very easy to reach. We have the best location next to the Galata Tower at the intersection of Karaköy and İstiklal Street
Our apartments have the comfort that will make you feel at home and provide Turkish bath services to our valued guests
Thank you for choosing us to provide you with a reliable and luxurious accommodation experience💐

reviews.text:
Great location, very close to Galata tower, Istiklal, Taskin Square and many more places. The host was welcoming and considerate to leave a welcome souvenir gift for us which is appreciated.
This particular unit was located on the 3rd floor with a narrow winding staircase leading up to it. If you are traveling with lots of luggage I would highly advise against this unless you have enough help. I also arrived in the mid of the night and that was an issue I faced as I had to carry almost 13 bags all by myself, this was not described in the listing and I failed to confirm this with the host. For the unit itself, it was comfortable, but one of the bedroom right across the door did not had any AC or fan and it could get hot. My kids though who slept there did not complain which was good.
The bathroom could use some updates like installing hooks or liners for clothes/towels.
All in all, enjoyed our stay except that I had to get all bags up and down those winding stairs. Thanks!

The location is absolutely unbeatable, you’re right by Galata Tower, in the middle of everything, but thanks to the insulation it’s really quiet inside. That’s the biggest plus of this place.
There are a few things to be aware of. The shower has a traditional marble basin (kurna), which for us just felt like it got in the way since we’re not used to it. Only one of the bedrooms has air-conditioning, which can be tricky in the hotter months. And it’s several flights up, so bear that in mind if stairs are a concern.
On the other hand, the kitchen is well set up, the sofa and TV made it easy to relax, and the little Galata Tower statue left as a gift was such a thoughtful touch.
Overall, I’d definitely recommend staying here. The location alone makes it worth it, and the other points are just small things to know in advance.

Location is great, minus the loud speakers right outside the apartment. Prepare to be woken up at 430am as there is no soundproofing. Two comfy beds although the room at the front does not have AC and gets quite hot. Kitchen wasn't well stocked, only enough plates/bowls for 2 people (there were 3 of us), one pan, no spatula, no pots.. Bathroom was stunning, although the shower needs a good deep clean. Apartment is on the third floor, no lift. Overall happy but there are certain things we wish we were made aware of prior to booking.

Location is very central. Because of this, it can be quite loud. To be honest, you can’t hear anything from the street, it’s more the Muslim alarm. The rest was fine. It was also great to be so central and don’t have to spend much time with transportation. You have so many restaurants nearby it’s great! You leave your place and you are immediately “turisting”.
Overall it’s an amazing Airbnb at a great price. Everything was clean and looked really nice. The host was very responsive and when something was missing (like the hair dryer) he immediately called someone to bring a new one. 100% recommend!

Our stay in Istanbul was absolutely wonderful. The apartment of Necmettin is beautiful, modern, and very comfortable. The location couldn’t be better; it’s right in the heart of the city, with everything you need just a short walk away. The host is very kind and helpful. We would definitely love to come back and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul.

description:
Discover the beauty of Istanbul from this spacious 1-bedroom apartment. This space features a living room with a cozy sofa bed—perfect for relaxing after a day of sightseeing. Enjoy amenities like heating, air conditioning, WiFi, and a washing machine.

Just steps from Taksim and the famous Istiklal Avenue, the apartment sits in one of the city’s most central locations. Located in a bright, airy building with an elevator, it offers both comfort and accessibility.

reviews.text:
I had a very pleasant stay at this Airbnb. The place was clean and well-maintained, and the location is excellent. Main attractions and Istiklal Street are within walking distance, which made getting around very easy. There are also many great restaurants and cafés nearby.
The unit itself is spacious, with a comfortable and nicely set up bedroom. It felt like a great place to relax after a long day of exploring the city.
Pros:
Very clean and well maintained
Excellent location, close to Istiklal Street and main attractions
Many great restaurants nearby
Spacious unit
Nice and comfortable bedroom
Cons:
I was traveling with a toddler, so it’s worth noting that there are a few steps before reaching the elevator. If you can carry a stroller, it’s not an issue. The owner kindly informed us about this during booking, which I really appreciated.
The elevator is quite small and can accommodate only two people at a time, but again, this was not a major issue for us.
**Highly recommended**

I had a fantastic stay at Sedat’s place! The apartment was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Sedat was an excellent host, very friendly and responsive, making sure everything was perfect for my stay. The location was great, and I felt right at home. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a great Airbnb experience. Thanks again, Sedat!

Cozy bir daire ve aynı fotoğraftaki gibi. Evin konumu ve temizliğinden memnun kaldık. Ev çok iyi ısınıyordu ve duş konforluydu. Televizyonun büyük olması, mutfak ekipmanlarının tam olması gibi detaylar bizi mutlu etti. Konumu dolayısıyla gürültü gelmemesi imkansız ancak bizi rahatsız etmedi. Taksim’in canlı hayatının içinde olduğumuzu hissetmeye devam ettik. İyileştirme önerisi olarak taze çaylar ve kahve ile çay makinası/french press detayı mutfağa eklenebilir.

It is very beautiful apartment with nice furniture. It seems as the photos . Location is amazing . Busy street at night but love it . We like everything about the place and good value for money . The owner is very helpful and easy going . Thank you for the lovely stay .

I really liked this place. It is located in the heart of Taksim Square, easy to find, has all the amenities, everything matches the pictures and of course very clean. Sadet is a very helpful and kind host. I had a good experience here. The only thing if you are a light sleeper is that the walls here are not very soundproof, but for me it is not a problem.

description: Relax with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay.

reviews.text: Description was inaccurate very rude during communication when raised issues they said that I have made a big issues of small issues there was stinking smell in bathroom during the whole period of our stay the host just said it is drainage problem didn’t fix it we have to be away most of the time only came to sleep late night we had to spray rooms just to cope with the awful smell also there was marks of leak on wall in the living room the host didn’t bother to get it painted house wasn’t as described as no instructions to use the boiler and no description about the number of stairs to reach the flat

Amazing location overlooking bosphorus and water views. Gorgeous sunrise and listening seagulls, extremely peaceful. Both bedrooms upstairs main has a balcony and living kitchen downstairs with the second balcony. Everything was well taught. Management company was responsive and supplied everything needed. Arnavutkoy is a very unique and local neighborhood, highly recommend this spot.

I had a great stay here! The house was very clean, neat, and comfortable, and the view was absolutely perfect—definitely one of the highlights of the place.
Parking was a bit confusing at first since the house is located on a no-exit street, but there are paid parking lots very close by, which made things much easier once I figured it out.
Overall, I really enjoyed my stay and would happily come back!

Very helpful and informative communication from host. We had an amazing one night it worth almost 100 nights going to bed and waking up to one of the best views in the whole world was nothing less then spectacular.

This is one of my best accommodations I’ve ever been to. Waking up with the most beautiful view in the world is priceless. I visited Istanbul couple of times before on different locations but this one will be my final destination whenever I come back to that magical city.
The host was exceptionally polite and kind.
10/10

description: Rappel Suite No.6 has anything you need for a pleasant stay especially Panoramic Bosphorus View. The last thing you should worry about is your comfort on a holiday. Located in the center of the beautiful Istanbul City. 5 min walk to Taksim Square, 5 min walk down to the Kabataş Boat Station, Karaköy tram that takes 10 mins to the old city Sultanahmet. But the real city feeling to experience in the evening is just 3 min walk. The best bars and restaurants of the city are right behind the corner.

reviews.text:
We had a lovely stay in this studio apartment in the Cihangir area of Istanbul. The view over the Bosphorus and the Anatolian side of Istanbul was magnificent. Worth the price of the stay in itself.
This area is on quite a steep hill which was not a problem for us, but worth knowing if you intend to walk and use public transport to get over to see the historical sites. Cihangir has quite an artsy vibe to it, with plenty of lively places to eat and hang out.
The host was very communicative and answered promptly when we had questions, the bed was very comfortable and there was everything there that you would need. Just be careful if you get the ironing board out from behind the washing machine, as it is easy to catch the switch and turn the boiler off, leaving you with no hot water.
We would definitely recommend this host and when we come back we would choose this apartment again. Thank you.

Place is nice. Location is incredible. Great neighborhood. Apartment is good.. though some minor details to fix ( i.e. shower drainage overflows, some electric devices are hanging loose from the wall.
Amazing views to the city and Bosphorus but window glass could easily be cleaner in order to enjoy the view when sliding glass door is closed.
Over all good.
We stayed at the 6th floor which has no elevator access . Elevator works up until the 5th floor and then it’s only stairs. Nothing to worry but could be written in the description in case someone can’t do stairs..
Price -quality is good.
View and neighborhood are worth the stay.
Sina responds immediately and is very kind.

What a wonderful apartment. The pictures dont justify the view. The view is spectacular. Everything in the apartment was great and is very good value for money. The host is great with communication.
Just a note- that the lifts take guests to the 5th floor but there is another additional spiral stairs to walk up manually. This was ok for me (with luggage) but may not be suitable for elders or others with disabilities. However, the extra stairs give more height which provides an incredible view from the balcony.

The location couldn’t be better, and the view from the balcony is incredible! The interior is very efficient, comparable in size to a modest hotel room. There is one window that isn’t covered by the blackout curtains; it has a shade, but not fully light blocking. (This is visible in the photos, but it’s easy to miss, so worth mentioning.)
The main reason for 4 stars is that the shower floor is too level, resulting in water spilling around the shower area and onto the rest of the floor
There was also a housekeeping mistake before my arrival, but Sina was apologetic and very quick to fix the issue. (Thank you!)

Highly recommended!
The flat — and especially the incredible view (!!!) — is even better than in the photos. The area is beautiful, with lots of great cafés and restaurants nearby, and it’s close to many major sightseeing spots.
The host is a true 10/10: super easy to communicate with and full of great Istanbul tips. I honestly couldn’t imagine a better host.

description: Welcome to our newly renovated corner flat in the heart of Istanbul. Located just 700 meters from Taksim Square, it offers the perfect blend of central convenience and quiet comfort. Set on the second floor of a traditional building, the apartment receives light from two sides and provides a peaceful retreat while keeping you close to the city's top shopping, dining, and cultural spots.

reviews.text: This apartment is much bigger than it looks in the pictures. It’s in a quiet street, but close to everything you could need. It’s also just a 10 minute walk to the ferry if you want to get to Kadikoy. Internet is very good and stable, shower is decent and the bed is comfy. I was there for a month and it was great. Owner is very responsive and helpful. Fully recommend

Konaklama yeri ve konumu bizi çok memnun etti. Her şey son derece temizdi ve ilandaki açıklamayla tamamen aynıydı. Özellikle, her konuda bize çok yardımcı olan ve ara ara nazikçe hâlimizi hatırımızı soran Harun Bey’i belirtmek isteriz. Kendimizi çok rahat hissettik ve bir sonraki İstanbul ziyaretimizde kesinlikle tekrar burada konaklamak isteriz. Çok teşekkür ederiz!

We absolutely loved our stay. The apartment is close to the pier and the city, with several grocery stores and bakeries just around the corner.
The unit includes laundry facilities, a hot shower, a full kitchen, and a large refrigerator. It’s very spacious inside and easy to find.
Public transport and the metro station are also nearby.

Photos don't give this place justice - it's much better and bigger in person. The location is not perfect, as you need to walk from Taksim a bit, but in the evening you are met with a beautiful Bosphorus bridge view and also have sok and macrocenter shops nearby, which makes the location a great one.

This was our second time here. The location is perfect with has easy access to public transport and a short walk to Taksim square and Istiklal street. The apartment has everything you need for a short stay. We had a late checked in because of our late flight. MR Harun was very nice and responsive while waiting for us to arrive. He also organised a VIP taxi transfer to the Istanbul airport for us with a very reasonable price. We’d certainly come back here anytime we would travel to Istanbul. Thank you MR Okan and MR Harun 😊

description:
A cozy and stylish apartment steps from Istiklal Avenue!
Located on the 1st floor (note: no elevator), this charming flat in the heart of Beyoğlu is a short walk from cafés, shops, major sights, and metro lines. It features air conditioning and is fully equipped for a comfy stay—ideal for couples or solo travelers.

Enjoy self check-in via a secure key box for a smooth, flexible arrival.
Modern, central, and welcoming – your perfect base in Istanbul.

There is a drying machine in the building.

reviews.text:
Great location within walking distance to the lively streets and central Taksim, yet the area itself is calm and quiet, the perfect balance. The apartment was clean, well-kept, and very cozy, making it a really pleasant stay. The host was friendly, responsive, and accommodating throughout. It’s ideal for two people, although the bathroom is on the smaller side and a bit tight.
A lovely bonus is the Sunday market just a few meters from the apartment, you can see it right as you step out onto the street. It’s highly recommended, with fresh fruits, vegetables, clothes, and much more.
A couple of small things to note: the floors can get quite cold, so bringing slippers is a good idea. The bed is on the firmer side, but I still slept well.
Overall, a very nice stay that I would recommend!

Great little apartment in a nice & calm area but still close to all the major attractions. The apartment was clean and the host was very responsive. We had a few issues in the apartment that the host helped to solve after the check in. Very good value for money overall, would definitely recommend!

Well located, on a quiet side street, close to a bus stop serving the city centre in 15 minutes. Ten minutes' walk from Istiklal. Pleasant accommodation for two people, warmly decorated. Very easily accessible private building. Good communication and very responsive. I recommend it.

Lots of great local restaurants with aforddable prices.There is a big market on sunday for clothes and food stuffs.Easily accessible to bus station.Walkable distance to istiklaal street and taksim square.We had a great stay.
If you are visiting Istanbul, i definitely recommend this place , near to taksim square, clean , and the host is very kind , and helpful

description: Located just a 1-minute walk from Istiklal Avenue and a 3-minute walk from the subway, our room combines comfort and pleasure. With its carefully thought-out details and warm atmosphere, it is ideal for our guests who want to feel the energy of the city up close. A peaceful stay awaits you where you will feel at home.

reviews.text: For that price you can't complain. The location is perfect for a sightseeing trip in Istanbul. You can easily reach your means of transport - whatever you choose to take - Nearby you will find tons of pubs and restaurant, and the best thing is, that you are so close to the popular Taksim street. Really loved the staff. So kind and helpful. They even organized a chill gathering in front of the hotel themself. But you have to be careful, if you are sensitive to noise pollution. On the weekend you will hear a lot of loud music from the nearby pubs. And fyi: We booked the smallest room, which really is small, but nevertheless cozy and comfy. If you like more space, go for the other rooms. All in all we were so happy to stay at this place. Would definitely recommend.

One of the best places you can stay in Beyoglu area. Very close to Karakoy ferry station, where you can go across Bosphorus to Kadikoy. Just behind the popular bar streets. Space is super clean and tidy. Self check in possible. Go for it.
Respectful hosting, good location, comforty room
Clean, very stylish design, big bed, safe, wifi works fine. Pretty quiet most of the time, though Friday and Saturday nights you can hear some partying. Would book again.
Incredible, friendly and helpful host. He went above and beyond to accommodate us. He even gave us a free upgrade on rooms. Located in a super cool neighborhood. I highly recommend this place.

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Eddy's place for 5 nights. The apartment was exceptionally clean, neat, and well-maintained, making us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. It truly felt like a home away from home and is definitely a place we would love to stay at again on our next visit to Istanbul.
The kitchen was fully equipped with everything we needed, which was perfect for our group of six adults as we cooked most of our meals. The location is also excellent, with easy access to Taksim Square and public transportation, making it convenient to explore the city. Eddy was an outstanding host. Very friendly, responsive, and always willing to help. He shared plenty of useful information about Istanbul, including recommendations and even two music videos by local singers, which gave us a lovely introduction to Turkish culture. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a clean, comfortable, and well-located place to stay in Istanbul. Thank you, Eddy, for making our trip so memorable!

The place was absolutely amazing! Super affordable and honestly felt like a hidden gem for the price we paid. Everything matched the pictures perfectly — from the rooms to the amenities. The apartment was spotless, the location was convenient, and all the services provided were just perfect.
A special thanks to our host Ekrem — he was incredibly helpful throughout the stay. Any time I had a question or concern, he was quick to respond and went out of his way to assist me. 5 out of 5, without a doubt. Highly recommend to anyone looking for great value, comfort, and a helpful host!

The apartment is very clean and cozy. Suitable for a big family like us. We felt at home and Eddy was so welcoming and supportive. The apartment location was great, very close taksim and has lots of restaurants around it. The only issue was the music and noises from downstairs (restaurants and cafes) can easily be heard. But overall I do recommend this apartment.
The apartment is exceptionally spacious, clean, and well-maintained. Notably, the host, Eddy, demonstrated remarkable cooperation, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable stay for all.

Some places are more than just somewhere to sleep—they become part of the journey. This Airbnb was exactly that. Beautifully designed, spotless, comfortable, and thoughtfully equipped with everything we needed. Waking up here each morning and coming back after a day of exploring made the trip even more special. Thank you for creating such a welcoming space. I'd happily stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting.

description: ou'll have a great time at this comfortable place to stay.

reviews.text:
I had an excellent stay and would definitely recommend this Airbnb to anyone visiting Istanbul. The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos and matched the description perfectly. It was very cozy, exceptionally clean, and felt brand new. I also felt very safe throughout my stay.
The location is fantastic, with shops, restaurants, and Taksim Square all within easy walking distance, making it very convenient to explore the city.
The host was outstanding, always responding very quickly and happy to help. When I asked for a multi-plug for my phone charger, they brought one within minutes, which I really appreciated. They also provided fresh, clean towels, tissues, and bin bags, showing great attention to detail and guest comfort.
Everything was smooth from check-in to check-out. Thank you for the wonderful hospitality. I would happily stay here again and highly recommend this place to future guests!

Fortunately we only stayed for one night because it was not a comfortable stay. First of all, the host didn’t greet us or smile but rather seemed bothered to be there. The apartment is on the 3rd floor with no lift so be aware. The apartment is clean and new but the pillows need to be replaced. Terrible, we both woke up with sore necks. The worst part is the noise: even with the windows closed the sound of the nearby mosque felt like it was in our room! Lots of noise from the street too. We couldn’t sleep.

The location is excellent, right next to Taksim Square and many pedestrian areas filled with restaurants and shops. The apartment feels very secure due to the double doors. Inside, its clean and tidy with a reliable internet connection. You can tell they put a lot of effort into making the design fresh and beautiful it was a pleasure to stay there.
Special thanks to the host for the great communication he always replied very quickly. Because of a flight delay, we missed the check in deadline, but the host was very understanding and stayed an extra hour for us, which we truly appreciated. Im very happy with my stay!

The place and location were great, well worth the money. The only small issue was that the bathroom had a noticeably musty smell. The host's messages to me were also unnecessarily rude and aggressive but overall the check-in and checkout processes were very smooth

As a budget Traveler this was the best place I have stayed in Istanbul. Having a mini kitchen and washing machine was huge plus. The location is far enough off the main road there is hardly any noise, which is almost impossible in Istanbul. 10 min walk (max) to Taskim

description: When you look at the listings, you can see 3 listings for the same apartment because we used the same furniture sets when designing them. The apartments have the following differences: one plus one and two plus one, so the prices vary. The location is very central, and the metro, Marmaray, public transportation, and shopping centers are within walking distance. description:

reviews.text:
We had a great stay at Maksun's place. Maksun is a friendly, responsive, and helpful host who was always quick to reply and happy to assist with any requests.
Although we were accommodated in a different apartment than the one shown in the photos, it was equally well equipped and even had an additional shower in the bedroom, which was a nice bonus. The apartment was very clean, and the windows provided excellent sound insulation, making it quiet despite being in the city.
Another big advantage is that pets are welcome, so we were able to stay comfortably with our cat.
Overall, we had a very pleasant experience and would happily stay here again😊

Unfortunately, we had bad exeprience staying in this apartment. We booked two nights but had to move out after the first night because of the terrible noise from the nightclub located high up in the building beside the apartment. We woke up at around 5 AM from walls shaking and loud music.
We understand it´s not the hosts fault, but we don´t understand how people write the apartment is soundproof since the nightclub is open all days a week and plays loud music approx. 4-7 AM. Are some of these reviews scam? The host offered us another apartment in the same building but it was located on the second floor and considering how crowded and lively the street outside is at night, we refused it. We also didn´t see the apartment was clean enough (hair on the floor, stains on some furniture and dust on the sofa). Cigarette smell from the ventilation in the bathroom was also terrible.

We had a wonderful stay at Maksun’s apartment and I would highly recommend it to anyone visiting the area. The location is perfect — it’s close to everything you might need, with shops, restaurants, and transportation all within easy reach.

description:
Welcome to a Historical Home

This house is more than a stay—it’s a hidden doorway linked to the old Pammakaristos Monastery across the street, now Fethiye Mosque. Legend says the priest once lived here, watching over prayers and secrets. Beneath, the stone cellar held silent prayers; its low door made all bow in respect. These walls still echo ancient whispers of faith. May you feel this spirit, honor it, and always find your way back to this sacred place's story.

reviews.text:
The house has potential, but our stay was disappointing due to its condition and how our complaints were handled.
We stayed as a family of four. The downstairs bathroom door could not close at all - a serious privacy issue. The garden was in poor condition, with overgrown grass, rubbish, cat feces, and dirty chairs. Some floors were not properly cleaned.
We reported these issues about 30 minutes after check-in. The host first agreed to arrange cleaning and repairs, but later said some issues weren't real, that we were exaggerating, and that we should clean some areas ourselves.
We contacted Airbnb Support, but the host still didn't fix the issues during our stay. Communication became unnecessarily confrontational.
We never wanted to cancel - we just wanted the basic issues addressed so our family could stay comfortably. That didn't happen, and it significantly affected our experience.
Beyond that, it's also worth noting that the fridge was very small for a family of four.

An absolute gem in the heart of Istanbul! Staying here felt like living in a piece of history—the restoration work on this 800-year-old home is truly remarkable, successfully preserving its original historic charm while maintaining a beautifully kept and wonderfully spacious interior.
The house was spotlessly clean and equipped with everything you could possibly need, from fresh bedding and towels to a fully stocked kitchen. Having a private back garden with outdoor furniture right in the city was such a rare and unique find.
Our host greeted us warmly upon arrival and was incredibly accommodating when our ETA changed. Located right in Balat, the position couldn't be better—it’s a vibrant, lovely neighborhood filled with unique local sellers, charming cafes, fantastic restaurants, and rich history around every corner (including the historical link to the old Pammakaristos Monastery right across the street).
We couldn't have asked for a better experience!

This house was incredible... the view of the Fethiye Mosque was amazing; we were disappointed that it's under restoration, so we couldn't go inside. Toskan was very responsive to all of my messages, and was so helpful and eager to please. We were grateful that he let us check in early, as we arrived exhausted at 6:30AM. I'd highly recommend this place if you're looking for a comfortable and roomy home, and being able to walk to the Balat district was also a plus.

Toskan was an excellent host, extremely accommodating, responded so quickly. He helped us find the home at arrival and helped with some items we had accidentally left behind. The home is located in a non-touristic neighborhood, immersing you in the local culture. The view from two of the bedroom windows is of a beautiful mosque, where you will hear the call to prayer early morning. It was a truly unique experience. The Hagia Sophia is about 30-45 minutes away via public transportation and walking around the neighborhood gave us a good sense of the true Istanbul, which we appreciated. Overall a great experience.

Ardit Toskan's house, to me, seems the very reason airbnb exists. Planted across from an old Byzantine mosque in the middle of an completely non-touristic neighborhood, with antique elements in every room, and the call to prayer ringing in through the many windows, this house not only made a full immersion into Turkish culture possible, it also made us feel right at home there. We were gathering with family who rarely travel and felt nervous - Ardit arranged everything to make it easier for them - arranged a large transfer cab that carried 6 people for pick up at the airport and arranged the payments himself so we would not get swindled by the drivers, told us about local restaurants where we were showered in freebies, etc. His place is in the old muslim quarter, so no one speaks english, the narrow cobbled alleys are jam-packed with life, the call to prayer wakes you up in the morning and heralds you to bed. If you want authentic, big-hearted, real Istanbul - look no further!

reviews.text:
Home in Istanbul. I stayed for 3 nights and it was wonderful to meet all three of them. Emre welcomed me during the arrival and Merve & Arif helped me during the departure. Before & during my stay, communication was super easy and quick.
The place itself is super cozy, comfortable & clean, exactly like in the photos. Easy access to kitchen & I had the bathroom for myself the entire time. In all, a very good base in Istanbul.
The neighborhood is called Omer Hayyam; and I felt very safe there. It has a local residential atmosphere which I really like. I usually left in the morning & tried to be back home around 8PM, so not too late in the evening.
I took the bus when going for sightseeing (there's a bus stop just before the underpass, going to Eminonu) & going back to the house I usually took the tunel from Karakoy or metro to Sishane; then continued with the historical tram & getting off at Galatsaray Lisesi (School) & walk through a small alley behind Istiklal Cad. (I believe they were Balik Sokagi & Sahne Sokagi), goes under the underpass, & continue all the way towards Omer Hayyam Cad.
If there's one thing you should pay attention to when you first arrived, is to have lots of patience to find the taxi that will take you there (took me 3 taxis before I found 1 who was willing to find the address & use the meter). If you rely on free wifi, perhaps upon arrival you can sit in one of the cafe / restaurant, normally they have free wifi, and use it it order an online taxi - cutting all the hassles. As for the rest of the trip, I used public transport (got my Istanbulkaart at the metro station in airport) & for going to the airport bus stop, Merve helped ordering an online taxi - super easy. A highly recommended place to stay in Istanbul!

This was a great place to stay near Taksim! The flat is very close to Istiklal shopping street, but just far enough that the 24/7 noise and bustle of the popular tourist street are not a bother. The immediate area is full of locals, which gives an authentic Turkish experience and helps keep the prices affordable at the nearby markets (not tourist prices!!). There is a local street/farmers market on Sundays that was very fun to walk through and buy fresh fruits and vegetables.

The whole house is clean and very well designed. My room was modern and very comfortable. The house has super fast wifi, which is not common in Turkey :) Merve has great communication skills, and speaks English very well. She was flexible with meeting me to show me the location and give me the keys. Also, as her schedule permitted, we were able to have meals together, and she taught me how to make some local specialties. Thank you Merve for a great experience! I'd love to stay here again sometime, and I highly recommend this location to both short-term and long-term visitors.

reviews.text:

Located in the heart of a touristic location, our 2-bedroom, 1-living room apartment has been carefully designed to offer our guests both comfort and tranquility. Furnished with modern furnishings, our spacious and bright apartment will make you feel right at home.

With its fully equipped kitchen, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and comfortable beds, it's ideal for short or long-term stays. It's within walking distance of the city's attractions, restaurants, and shopping areas.

reviews.text:
The hosts were responsive and kind, and even brought us sweets, which was a nice gesture. The shared terrace was also enjoyable.
However, the apartment felt smaller than expected. The listing photos also appear quite edited—brighter and cleaner-looking, with imperfections seemingly smoothed or blurred out so the place had a noticeably different feel in person. There was also an unpleasant sewage smell from the bathroom.
The biggest issue was the electricity repeatedly going out during our last two days, which was inconvenient and made us concerned about our electronics.
Overall, we appreciated the hosts and location, but these issues affected our stay.

Konumu harika, ulaşımı çok rahat. Ev sahibi ve ekibine iletişimleri ve giriş-çıkıştaki yardımcı tavırları için teşekkür ederiz. Güvenli bir noktada ve fiyatı uygun.

Banyo ve klozet yeterince temizlenmemişti ve banyoda kötü bir koku vardı. Çarşaflarda gördüğümüz saçlar da hijyen konusundaki güvenimizi kırdı. Evin üst katındaki alan lokantaya ait, eve özel bir teras değil. Konumu ne kadar iyi olursa olsun, hijyen ve evin genel atmosferi nedeniyle evin içinde vakit geçirmeyi tercih edemedik. Temizliğe daha çok özen gösterilmesi durumunda çok daha iyi bir konaklama noktası olabilir.
Good value of monies given the location. Super friendly host and amazing Turkish hospitalities. The space a bit smaller than in photos , but totally understandable given its location

This apartment is centrally located about five minutes walk from the Blue Mosque and Sultanahmet square. It's also within walking distance of Topkapi Palace and many other attractions. The host was very friendly responsive. Apartment has air conditioning which is a big bonus in the Summer months.

We had a great stay in this apartment in Istanbul. The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. The location was excellent, with everything we needed nearby. Check-in was very easy and convenient. The host was helpful and responsive throughout our stay. I would definitely recommend this apartment and would be happy to stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay! Our second time in Istanbul and decided to try a different area. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The hosts were kind, responsive, and made everything easy. The location was great, and we loved being so close to İstiklal Caddesi, cafés, restaurants, and public transportation. Just keep in mind that the apartment is on a steep hill, so if you plan to walk to and from İstiklal every day like we did, you’ll definitely get your steps in! 😄 It wasn’t a problem for us, but it’s something future guests should know. We had a great stay! The apartment was very clean, comfortable, and exactly as shown in the photos. The location was excellent, with easy access to everything we needed. Check-in was simple and hassle-free, and the host was friendly and responsive. I would definitely recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again. Thank you!

Great place, especially for solo travelers. Everything is within walking distance; there is a market and a pharmacy right across the street. Istiklal is on the right, and Galataport is on the left. It's close to the metro, tram, and ferries. The apartment was clean and had all the essentials. The AC and TV worked perfectly.
The only downside is the spiral staircase, which makes it a bit difficult to carry a suitcase up and down on your own. Also, there is no parking nearby, as the building is located right on the street. The area is safe in the evening, but there is no lighting right in front of the building - it would be perfect if you could add some 😅 But there are security cameras, which is great!
Thank you so much for hosting me for such a long stay. Everything was fantastic!

description: Enjoy a memorable stay in this bright and spacious 3-bedroom apartment in the heart of Galata, accommodating up to 7 guests. One bedroom offers a stunning Galata Tower view and a partial Bosphorus view. With 4-meter-high ceilings, wide sunlit windows, two queen bedrooms, one twin room, a fully equipped kitchen, and 1.5 bathrooms, it’s ideal for families or friends. Surrounded by antique shops, vintage stores, and art galleries—just minutes from lively İstiklal Avenue.

reviews.text:

Beautiful apartment with wonderful balcony and great views.

description: Our apartment is on the 4th floor. It has its own large terrace, the rooms have an electric stove, microwave, kitchen utensils, Smart TV, air conditioning and heater. It is centrally located within a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Avenue.

reviews.text:
The accommodation was in a great location — about 10 minutes from Taksim Square and around 15 minutes from Galata Tower. There was also a bus stop just 2 minutes away with buses going to the city center, which was very convenient.
What we liked the most was definitely the terrace and the beautiful view from it. The apartment looked exactly like in the photos.
The only things missing were an iron and a broom. I discussed the iron with the host and in the end we managed without it. We also would have appreciated a larger supply of toiletries, but there are several shops nearby where we could easily buy what we needed.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and appreciated the convenient location and lovely terrace

The apartment is very nice, just like in the photos. There is a huge private terrace above it, with amazing view of the city. Very nice for heaving breakfast or dinner and enjoying the view. The location is excellent, just 5 minutes from Istiklal street. Everything was very clean.
Even though the neighborhood is quiet, other people in the building kept coming and going at all hours of the night, slamming their doors (and especially the front door of the building), so I had to use earplugs in order to not be constantly woken up. This could probably be solved if the owner talked to the other people in the building.
The terrace would be better with some small maintenance - the table is completely broken and unusable.

Firstly, I want to thank Rustam. He was such a wonderful person that really deserves to be a superhost. He was so communicative and responsive. He always asked me whether or not I need help. Let's get back to the place. It was like in the images. It was enough for two people. Also there was always hot water available. Location is wonderful. You can easily reach Istiklal Avenue. I could find the place without a hussle. I really loved the experience. I thank Rustam for the hosting.

Konumu oldukça iyi, teras çok güzel. Tek sorun temizliğe daha çok dikkat edilmeli fakat ev sahibi oldukça ilgiliydi bu yüzden ilerleyen zamanlarda da kalmak için ideal bir yer olduğunu düşünüyorum. Konumu oldukça iyi ve bu kadar yoğun bir yerde olmasına rağmen bir gürültü yoktu.

Evin konumu biraz ücra görünse de cadde üzeri ve sakin bir sokaktaydı. Güvenlikle alakalı bir problem hissetmedik. Merkezi olmasıyla birlikte rahatça ulaşım sağlayabildik. Genel olarak temiz ve sıcak bir evdi. İhtiyacımız olan her şeyi bulabildik. Terası da çok güzel fakat hava şartlarından dolayı oturamadık. Bir dahaki sefere umarım :)

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! Communication was excellent from start to finish, and our hosts were always available whenever we needed anything. The small welcome gift was such a sweet touch and made us feel very welcome. The apartment was exactly as described, very clean, and offered great value for money. It was also well connected and easy to get around. Highly recommended!

Konaklamamız boyunca her şey çok keyifliydi. Ev tertemiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Konumu çok rahattı, ev sahibi ise son derece ilgili ve yardımcıydı. Yolumuz tekrar düşerse kesinlikle yeniden konaklamak isteriz.

Great location near Taksim and walkable to many attractions in İstanbul. The room was clean and had all the required appliances for daily life. Stayed there with a friend for two weeks. building was very quiet. Host is helpful and responsive and reply very quick to messages. Highly recommended.

Everything was super nice. The apartment is in walking distance to many attractions and there's a bus stop nearby. The house itself was amazing! So many treats included like tea, coffee, water and snacks. On top of that, they leave small presents at the door which was very cute. We stayed for 5 days and it was a comfortable experience, definitely would recommend.

Konum olarak çok iyi 15 dk yürüme mesafesinde Galata kulesi, köprüsü Galataport, İstiklal caddesi gibi yerlere ulaşım sağlayabiliyorsunuz. Temizlik konusunda da gayet iyiler. Camlarda sineklik olmaması geceleri cam açmanızı biraz engelliyor çünkü direkt sinek giriyor içeriye. Banyoda duşakabinin tek camının olmamasından dolayı duş alırken suyun neredeyse hepsi dışarı akıyor. Bu sorunlar çözülürse çok daha başarılı bir işletme olacaklardır.

description: Stay in a luxurious place close to everywhere you want to visit.

reviews.text:
Thanks Hakan and team for a great stay.
Unbeatable location 2 min walk from the T1 tram and just a few min walk to all the must see locations. Clean place and amazing breakfast, found it quiet at night for a good night sleep too. This particular room was big enough for 2 people and overall it had all we needed - only thing to say is that it was extremely clean but it’s more dated than the pictures show, the tv was also inserted in a piece of furniture and we could not use the Google chrome we brought with us, which meant no Netflix. Other than that excellent stay for a very competitive price. We will be back :))

Hakan was an excellent host, and the hotel has a perfect location - everything like Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace, and Basilica Cistern is within walking distance. The breakfast was also really good. I’d definitely recommend it for anyone looking for a clean, affordable room with friendly staff and easy access to the main sights.

description:
I will be delighted to host my guests in my beautiful modernized home, located in a very quiet and safe location in one of the oldest and most historic areas of Istanbul.
My apartment is one of the most valuable apartments in Istanbul and is an important apartment named after the Italian architect Carlo Amancich.
It has a net usage area of 75 m2 and is decorated with modern furniture that can accommodate 7 people.
High-speed wifi, paid parking nearby and air conditioning.

reviews.text:
The apartment was great! It has a very convenient location — right in the city center, while the street itself isn’t too busy, so the noise from passersby doesn’t disturb your sleep. Please note that the apartment is located on the ground floor, but the curtains provide complete privacy. The apartment itself is spacious, cozy, and stylish. It has everything you could need — clean dishes, spices, an ironing board, a washing machine, and more. There is air conditioning in every room, which makes the apartment very comfortable to stay in.
I definitely recommend this apartment. The host was very welcoming and attentive to our comfort. Check-in was easy, and the apartment has excellent transport connections, with a metro station and tram stop nearby. Many of the city’s attractions are also within walking distance. Our stay was comfortable and safe, which definitely made our trip to Istanbul wonderful! Thank you!

Merkezi konumda harika bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadım. Son dakika planlamış olmama rağmen her şey son derece temiz, düzenli ve özenliydi. Ev, fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi; mutfak, banyo ve genel alanlar oldukça hijyenikti. Bu kadar merkezi bir lokasyonda böylesine ferah ve geniş bir yer bulmak gerçekten büyük bir avantajdı.
Yalnızca bir gece konakladım ancak uzun süreli kalışlar için de fazlasıyla uygun olduğunu düşünüyorum. Turistik amaçla gelenler için birçok gezilecek noktaya yürüme mesafesinde olması da büyük bir artı.
Ev sahibi son derece ilgili, nazik ve yardımseverdi. Tüm sorularıma hızlıca dönüş yaptı ve kendimi evimde gibi hissetmemi sağladı.
Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim, tekrar gelmek isterim 😊

The location was amazing - very central, with easy access to public transportation, especially the metro, and very close to major tourist attractions.
The apartment itself was perfect, honestly the best Airbnb we have stayed in so far.
It was extremely clean, very spacious, and had a bright, airy atmosphere. The bathroom was great, the living room was very large, and both the seating area and the bedroom were comfortable and generously sized.
The amenities were excellent, and the host was incredibly kind, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. The apartment is well-equipped with everything you might need, which made the experience even more convenient and enjoyable.
Overall, this was the best Airbnb we’ve stayed in, and I would definitely love to stay here again in the future.

5 Stars ++ Metin and Faruk are splendid host! Great communication with very easy and clear directions and instructions. Very generous with recommendation's. We went to all the restaurants and places that they shared with us and we loved all of them! The flat is very cozy! Exactly as the pictures show. Nice large shower. Very good for my over 6ft husband. Location is fantastic! You never have to walk more then 4-6 minutes to get to any form of transportation. Will absolutely stay here again. :)
Ev gerçekten fotoğraflardan bile daha güzeldi. Temizlik, konum ve ev sahibi ilgisi harikaydı. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik, tekrar gelmeyi kesinlikle düşünüyoruz.

description: My cool and comfortable one bedroom apartment with exposed "famous poet Orhan Veli's study room" has a true city feeling! It comfortably fits one maybe two and is centrally located on a quiet street, just two blocks from fish market. Enjoy a cafes, restaurants and pubs ... :)

reviews.text:
I was very upset that I had to wait another hour and half for room to be ready. I got confirmation that I can check in after 2 pm, I arrived around 15.30 but it wasn’t ready, they just started to clean. I was very tired, didn’t sleep at night. Room is very small and dark, personally for me it wasn’t comfortable. Another disappointment was when I realized that there is no iron, washing machine and dryer in the room. Everything was common and located downstairs. Moreover it was busy all the time with laundry and ironing bed clothes. But the lady who works there understood that I was very upset for that, offered me to put my clothes to the laundry when she is done. I am thankful for that.
These small things were important to me but I couldn’t get it.

This was my second time in Adroniki's apartments, I also stayed in one of the other rooms as well before. The location is the very best - in the heart of Besiktas. Room and bathroom are very clean. There is a stylish desk for remote workers. There is a big laundry room that you can use downstairs for free. If you are max 2 people, and planning to eat outside like me (the kitchenette inside the room is super small and there isn't any equipment except a kettle so it won't be very possible for you to cook), then this is one of the best accommodation choices you will get. Great value for the price.

All was good with Adroniki, really great location, very good communication and clean house. There was a problem on the hot water but thankfully it was solved quickly.
Thank you,

Stylish. Cozy. Sparkling clean. Perfect host. Lovely neighbours. Location is good, 5 minutes walk to vapur and bus station. The sweetest lady Hafiza that looks like sunshine will meet you and be there for you if anything is needed. You can do laundry, take extra towels, prepare snacks at the kitchenette - perfect for the long stay. There are lots of lovely cafes and restaurants nearby. The neighborhood is very colorful, interesting and full of life, so don't complain if it's also quite lively at night. Must visit nearby: "Moose Chocolatier" and "Minoa Books & Coffee". Will come again and recommend to friends.

we had a good time staying at this place.
Beşiktaş is one of the best places to be for a visit in Istanbul (Central, good transportation anywhere else, and the district itself is worth staying/living).
you have to know that Beşiktaş is one of the most active places in Istanbul and has a lot to offer (bars, restaurants, cafes, etc.)
the airbnb itself was also great. besides being a clean lovely place, the best thing here is Hafize abla, the person responsible for maintenance, check in etc.
she always was helpful and friendly and made us feel at home and taken care of :)
we mainly recommend this place for people (esp. couples) who explore the city rather than staying at home all the time since the apartments there are relatively small (but sufficient). staying as 2 people in there made it sometimes difficult to have privacy (bathroom-wise etc) but I guess this should be clear from the pictures and description of the apartments. all in all a good place and we can recommend booking it.

description: A modern and comfortable apartment very close to Merter, where you can feel the pulse of the city! A fully equipped residence awaits you 100 meters from the tram station, close to shopping centers. 🏠 Space Features: • New and safe building • Two bedrooms, guest capacity up to 6 • "Air conditioning in the living room" and fast wifi • Fully equipped kitchen 📍 Location Advantages: • 100 meters to the tram station • Walking distance to markets and restaurants • 30 minutes to tourist areas

reviews.text:
First of all, thank you very much, Oguz and Nihat, for your professional and friendly communication, as well as your continuous support and fast responses before and during our stay.
With your help and instructions, we had a very easy stay in Istanbul, starting from information about places to visit, restaurants, delivery application. In addition to that, you helped me to find a cheap parking place for my rented car.
The apartment was exactly as I have seen in the photos and the description, in addition to the cleanliness and facilities there, made us feel at home.
The location was perfect, in the middle of touristic places and shopping malls, safe place, close to Tram (2 min. walk) with many shops and restaurants close to the building.
Therefore, i find the paid price was worthy and suitable for the apartment.
If I plan a new visit to istanbul, most probably I will stay again in the same place.
Thanks a lot!

We had a great experience with Nihat. He is very polite and responsive. He also arranged a taxi to the airport for us, which was more affordable than Uber.
The place is exactly like the photos. It's close to the T1 tram station, taking around 50 minutes to reach touristic places such as Hagia Sophia by tram. The neighborhood is good, and there is a mosque in front of the building, so the call to prayer in the early morning hours may be noticeable.
Overall, I recommend this unit, especially if you want to stay in a neighborhood with more locals and traditional values.

Oguz is the best host you will ever meet his English is perfect and will help you with anything without Oguz I will be lost in Istanbul. His house is absolutely clean and spotless,the air condition is really strong which was good because of the weather I stayed in. I felt so comfortable it felt like home honestly.The location is absloutley perfect because the tram is 1 miniute walk and theirs shops everywhere. Thank you very much Oguz I can’t thank you enough .

Ev yeni ve tertemiz. Aile ile gelenler için de çok uygun. Çevrede ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz marketler, kafeler mevcut. Özellikle tramvay durağının evin hemen yanında olması büyük bir avantaj. İstanbul'da tramvay ve metro durağına yakın olmak gerçekten çok konforlu.
Ev sahibi Nihat Bey çok iyi bir insan. Sürekli bizimle iletişimde kaldı ve bir ihtiyacımız olup olmadığını sordu. Özellikle namaz kılanlar için cami de oldukça yakın. Türkiye'nin yerel halkı ile iç içe yaşamak isterseniz, burası en doğru tercih olacaktır.
P.S. Turistik bölgelere kıyasla burada fiyatlar oldukça uygun ve turist olduğunuz için gereğinden fazla ödeme yapmazsınız.

Oguz and family are always so welcoming, hospitable and friendly. The space is always always clean and well stocked with anything you’ll need, if you ever find yourself without anything they’re more than happy to help.
I have stayed multiple times throughout my years in Türkiye and it has to be one of my favourites. Beautiful apartment, wonderful location with plenty of shops and public transport access just a road away. Fresh linens, fresh towels. All amenities you’d require. I cannot emphasise how clean and comfortable it is to stay here.
I would recommend any of their places if you’re looking for somewhere. A huge thank you to you and your father and see you again next year!

description: It is a pleasing, historical building in the middle of Taksim/Beyoğlu, in Galatasaray - Cezayir Street. It's the centre of the city with many cafes, bars, art galeries etc.

reviews.text:
The place matches the pics and it's located in a very central area close to İstiklal and Kabataş. It had all the comforts needed, it was clean and the flatmates were nice. Selen came every week to clean the common areas and was always responsive if anything came up. I would definitely recommend this flat for a long stay!
The only aspect that might be challenging is the live music coming from the street, which sometimes could be a bit annoying.

This flat is located on a little side street with a bunch of restaurants below with live music pretty much every night, and on the weekends its especially lively and music can be playing as late as 1-2am in the morning. For people who don't stay up really late, sleep light, and can't deal with noise, this is not a good choice for you. I myself really liked it and slept really good. The flat is very central. It's a short walk to central Cihangir, Istiklal street where you can walk towards Galata tower or Taksim. The walk down to the Bosphorus isn't far either, where you can check out Galataport shopping center or head over towards the Karakoy ferries and Galata bridge. I stayed at the flat for 30 days. There are 4 bedrooms total, and I shared the flat with younger students which was pretty cool. Its an old building in an old city and I set my expectations accordingly and was happy. The host's are excellent and very responsive. I would stay here again, thank you! :))

I had a great time at selens place.
It’s a shared apartment and 3 other young people lived there with me, for me that was perfect :)
Selen is an amazing host! She is super friendly and obliging. If there is a problem in the apartment, she will take care of it immediately.
The apartment is in a very central and touristic area of Istanbul. You can reach many sights very easy by Tram, Bus or walking :)
The only not so good thing is the noisy alley in front of apartment. But I got used to it :p

This apartment is a rare find right where the action is! The home was cozy and warm. Selene was very kind and came and did professional cleaning every week. The guests were all interesting international travelers during my stay. My room had a cute little balcony to sit on. The alley outside is quite loud because the place is over a row of bars. If you are a light sleeper, try to book one of the other rooms in the back of the house.
The place felt like a home, nice neighborhood, great location.

description:
Only available for long-term stays, with a minimum of 101 days.
Antique jewel in the heart of Istanbul. This historic building was refurbished a few years ago.

Ask for monthly prices. Weekly cleaning included.

You can enjoy strolling through hip neighborhoods like Cihangir, İstiklal Caddesi, Karaköy, Galata Tower(all within 5-6 mins. as well as Şişhane metro and Tophane tram stops)

Unique and receives ample daylight, has hight ceilings and reflects the old Istanbul in subtle ways.

reviews.text:
Overall we had a good experience! The host Muhlis was super helpful, always responded very friendly and was very quick to resolve any problems or answer any questions. Thank you!
About the apartment itself. Great location, nice decorations, cozy, all amenities are provided. We saw comments about the small kitchen but it was fine for us, no discomfort. Nevertheless, some things require repair (lights, handles) and some extra cleaning.
However, taking into account that it's not a hotel and considering the reasonable price, we can say that it mostly met our expectations. Would recommend it to others.

Thanks to Muhlis and Kadriye ! He responded always quickly. Kadriye always come quickly to the room to help me out. My Last day , Muhlis helped me so much to get a taxi . It is always hard to get taxi in Istanbul. I must say , I really enjoyed my stay. The location was perfect. Galataport and Taxim square are Walking distance. The room was so warm ( I was staying in Nov to Dec ) and hot water shower was powerful with great shower head. There are many windows and so bright all day long. Everything I needed were there. From my room did not have nice view but upstairs has great harbor view. There is no elevator , Kadriye helped me my luggages to bring up to my room. I definitely recommend !!
I would love to come back again. For the next stay , I want to stay at much more higher flat in the same building for beautiful harbor view and sky view.

I enjoyed my time in Istanbul very much. In part, it is due to the convenience of this apartment. I spent six weeks in the apartment, and easily commuted to Boğaziçi University daily. You are a 6 minute walk to Tophane, 3 minute walk to Istiklal / Sishane metro stop. The apartment is very sunny with all its windows. It is perfect for one person and for couples. You’ll have to buy your own laundry detergent, soaps, but toilet paper, water, and towels are available when you first check-in. The area is a great place for walking around, going to one of the many cafes, and for visiting a museum. The apartment is very clean and renovated. I would highly recommend this apartment.

Stay was very pleasant, thanks to the owner.
Location is very good, it's a walking distance to Taksim, Cihangir, Galata, Eminonu. But it's hilly around, so be ready to climb stairs.
Owner is very helpful. He responds to messages very quickly. Easy to check-in and checkout.
Apartment is relatively small but okay for two people. There is cute decor and stylish retro vibe. Wifi is good.

The apartment is very unique and nice - may be it’s not as new and fresh as in the pictures but it doesn’t really matter, the atmosphere and design are great. The host is very supportive and friendly! The location is great - it’s near Galataport, Istiklal street and metro/tram stations. But you should be able to climb up the hills in this part of the city if you choose to live here. Also it may be loud to sleep - but it’s the heart of Istanbul :)

description: A cosy, shiny, and spacious studio with a terrace located in Beşiktaş, between Ortaköy and Kabataş districts. All the shops and cafes are near my apartment. Yildiz metro station and buses are 3 minutes away. You will enjoy sitting and chilling on the terrace.

reviews.text:
This was truly one of my best Airbnb experiences ever, thanks not just to the lovely apartment itself, but also the extremely hospitable host! Ayda was extremely responsive before my arrival, giving excellent instructions and advice on how to get to her place, and rally helpful with any question I had then or during my stay. She even went out of her way to make sure I got a taxi to get to the airport when it was time to leave.
As for the place itself, it is lovely, comfortable, and extremely clean, with all that one could need. I loved the neighbourhood it is located in - the Besiktas area - because there are so many great restaurants, cafes and bars around, all within walking distance. It's also a great location to be if you want to be away from much of the tourist crowd, as everything here felt very local and authentic. The apartment is also just a short walk away from public transportation that got me anywhere I wanted to go. It also felt extremely safe even when I walked back alone later at night.
I would only say that, if you prefer to be very close to all the tourist areas, then this may not be the place for you - it takes about 30-40 mins to get there by bus/tram. However, to me, this was totally worth it to be able to see a different and more local side to Istanbul.
All in all, highly recommended!

We had a nice time at Ayda’s flat. Ayda was very kind and responsive throughout our stay.
The flat is well-furnished and situated on the ground floor / minus 2 floor, with a cozy little terrace that was especially enjoyable in the summer. The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you might need. The Wi-Fi connection is strong, which made remote work comfortable.
However, the flat does have a humidity issue that caused a smell when we were there. There can be some noise at times, and the curtains don’t block out the morning light completely, though we managed to sleep well.
The location is very convenient, with the Yıldız Teknik Üniversitesi bus stop nearby, making it easy to reach various parts of Istanbul by bus. The flat is also well-connected to Beşiktaş ferry station and Zincirlikuyu via the Gayrettepe Metro stop. In addition, nearby, there are two supermarkets (Migros and BIM)
Overall, we enjoyed our stay at Ayda’s flat and appreciated her hospitality

Ayda and her mother were very friendly and helpful. The apartment is very clean and comfortable. It has everything (wifi,tv,kitchenette,washing machine,dishwasher,terrace,etc ) The place is really well located, it's charming, cosy, and the perfect place to stay in Istanbul. I would highly recommend this place. Would definitely stay here again!
Thanks Ayda and Özden! :)
Ayda ve annesi inanılmaz güler yüzlü ve her konuda çok yardımcı. Daire %100 foroğraflarda göründüğü gibi,çok temiz ve konforlu. İhtiyacınız olan her sey evde mevcut. Daire Beşiktaş'ın en güzel yerinde ve her yere çok yakın konumda. Hiç düşünmeden tekrar orada kalırım ve herkese tavsiye ederim.
Çok teşekkürler Ayda ve Özden! :)
Ayda et sa mère étaient très amicales et utiles. L'appartement est très propre et confortable. Il y a tout (wifi, télé, kitchenette, lave-linge, lave-vaisselle, terrasse, etc.) L'endroit est vraiment bien situé, c'est charmant, confortable et l'endroit idéal pour séjourner à Istanbul. Je recommanderais fortement cet endroit. Je reviendrais certainement ici encore!
Merci Ayda et Özden! :)

Ayda was an amazing and gracious host. I stayed at her flat for 2 weeks.
• As a remote US based worker/digital nomad my main concern was WiFi visiting Istanbul. I was able to do my work like normal no issues including several zoom/teams calls, file sharing, uploading, etc no issues or lag as the flat has very fast/strong WiFi.
• The location is also great. There is grocery store at the top of the hill which is like a 3 min walk and super convenient for grabbing essentials.
• The flat was as described. And had pretty much everything you need to cook and feel comfortable
•Ayda herself was so kind and accommodating. She responded super quickly when I had questions. And provided recommendations for the area
•The location is great. There’s so many great cafes, shops, and train stop nearby.
Would definitely stay again!!

Ayda was a very attentive host. Even though I was late for check-in, she waited to greet me and personally explained the details of the house to me.
