I also received quick responses from her regarding my subsequent questions. Her house was tidy and her internet was very fast. Having a terrace was a major factor in why I chose the house, but opening and closing the door is a bit problematic, and it definitely needs a fly screen. Additionally, the biggest issue with the house is that it has a humidity problem that is noticeable by the smell. Apart from these issues, I was pleased with everything else. All the listed equipment was in working order and the location of the house is very central and close to many places. It is located in a residential area, so there is no noise problem.
Once again, Ayda was a very good host and I would like to thank her once again for making my stay in Istanbul easier.

description: Feel at home in this spacious and stylish residence, ideally located between the airport and the city center. Filled with natural light and overlooking green surroundings, it offers a calm and welcoming atmosphere. With comfy furnishings, a cozy memory foam bed, a large balcony, high-speed Wi-Fi, and air conditioning in every room, you’ll have everything you need. High-standard cleaning, 24/7 security, free parking, and access to hotel amenities make your stay easy and enjoyable.

reviews.text: Omer is a great host who was very kind to pick me up from the airport (sorry again for being late). He assisted me with everything I needed and was available during all the period I occupied his accommodation. His english is very good, so no problem of communication :) The flat is better than the pictures, very clean (even cleaner than some 5 stars hotels !) The bed and sofa are very comfortables. The decoration is modern and let you feel yourself at your own home, the building has a lift, a lobby, a reception and is secured 24/24 7/7. The area where the flat is located is close to CNR expo (exhibition center) and Ataturk airport (10-15min /less than 3€ by taxi), 30 min from the downtown (~12€). It is closed to outlet mall (you have to walk 45min even if it is near because we can not accross the high way !) otherwise we took taxi ~ 2€. It really worthes to stay at Omer's apartment. Thank you once more for everything and for sure I'll communicate your address to my friends and family...

I was looking for an apartment I could recover from surgery in for 9 nights. This apartment ticked all the boxes for me.
Apartment- absolutely like the photos. It’s fresh, modern, clean, spacious & cosy at the same time. Big windows, lots of light & has blackout curtains which allows you to keep the sun out if you want.
Balcony- 😍 so much room & gets sun all afternoon until late.
Fully stocked kitchen, big fridge/freezer, dining area.
Big shower & bathroom,
Extras included- WIFI, TV, NETFLIX & AIR CON all work very well. Had a decent hairdryer too BONUS.
Location very close to shops, restaurants etc, it is at the other side of highway (5 mins walk) so it is just far enough from any noise.
Environment very chilled, quiet area.
The Host- Ömer is fantastic. From booking he was so helpful & communication was great. He even helped organise transport from airport to apartment. Gives you space but available if needed. Lots of advice about the area. Was more of a friend than a host.😊

We had a wonderful stay at Omer’s apartment and couldn’t be happier with our experience. The apartment was beautiful, very clean, comfortable and exactly as described. Everything was well prepared for our arrival, and we felt at home straight away.
Omer was an absolutely fantastic host: kind, helpful, responsive and always available whenever we had any questions. His hospitality made our stay even more enjoyable and stress-free.
We would happily stay here again and highly recommend Omer’s apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. Thank you so much for everything! 😊

We had a wonderful stay at Omer’s apartment. The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos, very clean, modern, spacious, and well-maintained despite being a one-bedroom unit. Omer was extremely responsive, always quick to reply, and very helpful throughout our stay. He was respectful, kind, and made the whole experience smooth and comfortable for us.
We highly recommend Omer’s apartment and would be happy to stay there again in the future.
Friendly and welcoming host. Nice building with amazing pool and gym available at extra cost. Convenient market located right downstairs in the lobby.

description:
•Perfect location - 10 minutes walk to Blue Mosque. On the border of Old Town and Little Hagia Sophia & Local Restaurants & Supermarkets
•Apartment is located on the 2nd Floor
•Unlimited Free Wi-Fi
•Beautiful neighborhood with Authentic Ottoman Houses
•Comfortable beds, spacious bathroom
•New electronic equipment

reviews.text: Nice location in a quiet old district (not directly in the tourist area but in walking distance to historical centre). Very welcoming and helpful staff, we appreciated we could check-in in the middle of the night after our flight was delayed. The apartment was clean, nicely arranged and was exactly as described. We would definitely come back again.

Great location (Hagia Sophia was a 15 min walk!), host was responsive & was a lovely, clean place to stay! Loads of things to do, places to see & reasonably priced restaurants & grocery stores walkable from Mehmet’s place.
Highly recommend getting a data-only esim for when you’re out and about exploring (if you’re flying in & can’t speak turkish).

Mehmet's place was in a beautiful neighborhood, walking distance to Blue Mosque and Hagia Sofia. We were close to restaurants and supermarkets. The staff was always so responsive whenever I had questions and requests. We quite liked the place (only small con is that one of us who was staying in the living room had to go through the other bedroom to go to the bathroom). Other than that, I can't fault this place. Good value!

I highly recommend this mini cozy hotel. The apartment is better than I was expected. Good quiet place without noisy traffic but in the same time colourful old fashioned location. We could reach many of historical places on the foot. Our apartment were cleaned regularly. Hotel manager was so polite helpful and always available). We asked him a lot of questions and he always helped us). Thanks a lot. I will stay here again.

Apartment was as described and clean.
Mehmet was great host, always available when I messaged him.
I recommend his place :)

description:
FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION (Less than 1 minute distance) – FREE MINI BREAKFAST – EASY TO FIND – 3MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – NO CLEANING FEE – FREE LUGGAGE STORAGE – FREE BABY EQUIPMENTS – MARKETS & PATISSERIES NEARBY – ENTIRE APARTMENT (Not shared)

How we fight against COVID-19: We do the cleanings with masks and gloves. Our cleaning process is in-line with local & global rules and guidelines. We also have our own laundry and wash all bedsheets and towels 60c hot.

reviews.text:
The place was comfortable but small, and the location was OK! You need to walk daily on a slope for 15-20 min to get to the bus station, which wasn't an enjoyable part of my day. The location is kind of far away from everything! And it is located in the local area where there are only three shops and two coffee shops. The team is helpful and therefore you 24/7; we face a problem with our heating system and the security system, which is load and painful! Especially when it goes crazy after midnight! We did encounter a problem with it, and we heard other people facing the same problem with the security system within the building.
It's a good place if you are traveling on a low budget and looking for a place to sleep, and you don't have a problem being in remote areas far away from all activities.
The place is as described, but it wasn't the right call for me. We thank the host for his fantastic hospitality

We really enjoyed our stay at Istanberry Dream Flats. It was a little difficult to locate initially, but Guven was very helpful and instructed the taxi driver about how to get there. The flat was very clean, and exactly as described. We stayed there for four nights, and the flat was cleaned again in between our stay. The only minus was that there was no microwave in the flat, to heat up any food/leftovers.

The location of the flat is ideal, with close proximity to Taksim square and the Istiklal High street.Overall a very pleasant stay, and Guven was a very friendly and helpful host.

The apartment looks like in the photos and it was pretty clean. The host was very friendly and helpful. The breakfast is also really nice. The only issue is that the place is very noisy. You can hear the traffic and people walking by the bedroom window as well as every step of the neighbors. This is a bit annoying at night, but otherwise the place is great.

Guner's apartment was inexpensive and was the best property that I had ever rented in Istanbul. It was comfortable and was warm with adequate heating in the winter. Guner's apartments are conveniently located in central Istanbul and have a 24-hour reception. Therefore, guests can receive help from the reception whenever they have a problem. Guner is very kind, helps his guests beyond his duty and is a super host.

Guner Place is okay, but not without its issues. It's about a 7-minute walk to Taksim Street, which is super convenient for shopping and food. The area has plenty of stores nearby, but the metro is a 15-minute walk, which might be far for some.
The place is quite noisy, so if you're looking for a quiet stay, this may not be ideal. The water temperature in the faucet constantly changes and the pressure is inconsistent. Despite asking for help, the TV wasn’t fixed during our stay.
Also, be aware that it's located on a steep hill—something to consider if you're traveling with older people or have mobility concerns.
On the plus side, the staff were friendly and helpful, and the mini breakfast at the cafe was a nice money-saver, especially with how pricey things can be in Turkey.
Overall, a decent stay if you’re focused on location and don’t mind some inconveniences.

description: Designed with country-style decoration

reviews.text: Sevil and her husband were lovely hosts. Their home is gorgeous and very clean, and Ben better than the photos and much larger. We had everything we needed. Only thing I can say is that most beaches are private and the area is very particular to locals, so was not always comfortable as a tourist. We loved the water park that is only 3 min from the home. Thank you again!
Our stay at Küçükev was super nice and comfortable. Great location, spotless clean and tidy. Sevil hanem is very helpful and friendly. We will definitely visit again. 🌻

We throughlyenjoyed our stay at the guesthouse. They location is ideal as it's near the beaches, parks as well as a nice walk to the center of town. The hosts were gracious and the home was extremely cleaned, well-appointed and nicely decorated. The view and sea breeze will always be a wonderful memory of our time spent on the island.
Konumu sahilden 600 metre uzaklıkta, sakin, temiz ve iletişimi iyi bir ev sahibi. Ev oldukça yeni ve kullanışlı. Balkonu ve manzarası keyif için birebir. Sevil Hanım ve eşine teşekkür ederiz.

Everything about the place was amazing, location was near to the woods, the town center and shops, also the place was really clean and had neat details. Although, the price could be less than what it was.
I recommend this place to stay and enjoy the beautiful view from its balcony.

description:
FAMILY RUN BUSINESS – 24 HOURS RECEPTION – FREE MINI BREAKFAST – EASY TO FIND – 3MINS TO ISTIKLAL STREET – NO CLEANING FEE – FREE LUGGAGE STORAGE – FREE BABY EQUIPMENTS – MARKETS & PATISSERIES NEARBY – ENTIRE APARTMENT (Not shared)

How we fight against COVID-19: We do the cleanings with mask and gloves. Our cleaning process is in-line with local & global rules and guidelines. We also have our own laundry and wash all bedsheets and towels 60c hot.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay for 5 days. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and looked just like the photos. The highlight of our stay was the breakfast, which was absolutely wonderful. The kitchen had everything we needed, though adding some nicer quality dishes and cookware would be a great touch. Overall, communication and check-in were seamless, and we enjoyed our time here.

Was a good option and good value for that you get. If you’re very concerned about cleanliness (particularly of bedsheets and linens) this may not be the best place, but they seem very helpful and responsive. The washroom was on the old side and sink was very small, but the rest of the place was decently spacious for the city. Location was good, 4 min walk to transit and about 6-7 minutes to Istiklal/Taksim. Overall it was good and I’d recommend if you’re looking for value.

I stay in Güner-Berivan's other place before and it was very positive. They work like a charm. But this time I can't say that I was delighted. But first, the positive. Good location. Check-in/check-out without problem. Washer/Dishwasher/Iron/Hot water - all is ok.
The apartment looks good but tired. Also very poor lighting at dark time, a little bit depressing. The A/C when I turned it on to reduce humidity, smells like cigarettes smoke. Little spiders in bathrooms (very small about 1mm), they are really harmless but sometimes I found them on myself =) But the most exciting adventure was when I woke up in the morning and found that the second half of the bed was really wet =( It was rainy days and the ceil is leaking directly onto the bed. I told about it, some fellow came , took a foto... and that's it. So I spend the next (and last) night in this bed again. And judging by the condition of the ceiling, this problem is not new, the celling is water damaged.
I might use Güner-Berivan's service again in the future, but definitely not this apartment.

At first we booked the Basement room but it was unpleasant (it was very cold maybe from humidity and we can hear the upstairs guest talk through the window inside the bedroom till late night)
We complain to the staff and they offer us to upgrade the room, so next day we decided to upgrade the room (+60tl per night) and this room is so comfortable, clean and have everything you’ll need
We are so happy with the room :)
Lastly, all the staff at reception desk was very helpful and have service mind. they respond to my problems and questions so quick.

Not what I expected.. bathroom is very bad. all walls are at angle. no elevator. no air conditioning in the bedroom to keep the air moving. busy and noisy street you will not get an our of sleep without noise waking you up from the street..
but the host is very very very nice.

description: The building is located in Istanbul’s arts, entertainment, history and cultural district, in other words right in the middle of the city center, in Taksim / Beyoglu.

reviews.text:
Great apartment in a great location. The apartment really is historical with super high ceilings, brick walls and original hardwood floors. The space was nicely modernized and simply decorated. The space is big enough and is quite clean and comfortable. It feels like home. The building has a modern elevator. The building is located in a quiet little street parallel to Istiklal Street (a main tourist attraction). The street itself is super safe with 2 convenience stores, a bakery, a store that sells fruits and veggies, all open until late at night. You will also find kids riding their bicycles and playing: a typical Turkish experience. Around the corner, you must try the bakery that sells Turkish borek and croissant-like pastries. The apartment is a short walk (like 5 mins) from the Rixos Pera (for reference): from there, you can easily reach the middle of Istiklal Street, Galata and the Pera area, all super interesting! There's a superb view on your way there, overlooking the Golden Horn (if I am not mistaken). The apartment is also well connected in terms of public transport: 2 nearby bus stops - Omer Hayyam or Tarlabasi - with many buses stopping by and connecting you to most of Istanbul. If you prefer the metro, you can take a walk or one of the buses for a couple of minutes to either to Taksim or to Sishane and take the metro from there).
Finally, Taner and Nicola are both great and friendly hosts! You will run into them in the building as there is always one of them available on site. Communication with them is great and they are always available to solve any issues that may arise (happened twice with me).
I definitely recommend staying in this apartment: it has great value for money and gives you a taste of authentic Turkish experience while being in the middle of the action.

The location is very good, walking distance to main istiqlal street, ferry and bus stop. Check in was easy and Taner was also good at communicating and very responsive. However The place looked older and darker than the picture, it is also easily get dusty because they use industrialist wall design, so we asked for an additional cleaning in the 2nd day of our stay. The stove takes time to heat, so we cannot really cook much there. I don’t have any problem with the noise from outside, but just expect to have a more fuctional room given the price point.

The place is located in a good area where you can find convenient transportation options. Flats are lovely just like in the pictures. However, the beds are cheap, not comfortable, and not durable. Overall, the owners are very friendly and helpful even though they couldn't help us with the bed issue because of the curfew. One last thing, you can hear every single step from the upper floors along with conversation sounds (there is no sound insulation in the building because it's old)

We had a wonderful stay!
The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was very friendly and responsive, and the location was perfect.
We would definitely stay here again and recommend it.

My stay was just lovely at Taner and Nicola’s apartment. The local area is nice and everything is easily accessible. As a solo traveller it was just perfect and safe for me. The apartment is just like on the pictures with very nice decoration + perfectly clean! I slept very well in the cosy bed. Not to mention that Taner was very helpful by explaining everything I needed to know and being available whenever I needed something. Totally recommend! My stay for the first time in Istanbul was amazing and memorable and i’m definitely coming back!

description: located in the one of the oldest and most colorful quarters of Istanbul on the old peninsula. This is a friendly home away from home for couples and families.

reviews.text:
- Welcoming, kind and professional staff
- Room was clean
- Good/easy communication overall
- Warm and cozy neighborhood
- Overall 👍
Great place, excellent price, and amazing location, can’t beat that combo. The water did go out for 12 hours but that was a city wide issue and part of the experience 😆. I highly recommend
very good location and price to quality ratio, nice people
Perfect spot in walking distance of the Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar. Lots of restaurant options right outside.
very helpful with arranging a tour and taxi back to the airport. we enjoyed our stay

description: Experience Istanbul from your own private rooftop penthouse in the heart of Galata. Enjoy breathtaking Bosphorus, Galata Tower and Historic Peninsula views from your exclusive private rooftop terrace. Just steps from Galata Tower, Galataport, Karaköy, Istiklal Street, metro, tram and ferries. Perfect for families, friends and remote workers seeking comfort, privacy and one of Istanbul's most unforgettable views.

reviews.text:
Çınar’s place is the Galata area, very convenient for visiting Istanbul. We loved the location. When we arrived, we ran into the host at the entrance and he ended up checking us in personally. He was very friendly and welcoming.
The place is like the photos and large for 2 of us. It was clean and comfortable. The view from the roof top terrace is excellent. While it is near the Galata tower, it is quite quiet, while there are a lot of restaurants and shops within minutes of walking. I think it is a very good place to stay when visiting Istanbul, highly recommended.
Be prepared to walk uphill and walk up the stairs. There can be a lot in the area and the apartment is on the top floors too. However, it is worth it.

We stayed in Cinar's apartment for 8 nights in March, let me start with the positive things :

- Cinar was very helpful and responsive
- Location was great, very close to Galata tower, restaurants, bars etc.
And this is what we did not like..
- The apartment is smaller and older than what it looks like in the pictures
- The balcony is narrow, the terrace small and difficult to reach with a ladder. Also the balcony doors are difficult to open and close
- One of the beds was missing
- The cleanliness o the place was approximative, we found dust and hair when moving things around, the vacuum cleaner was also dirty so that we could not properly clean ourselves
-Twice the wifi did not work for a few hours
Overall it was not great, and for the price we paid, we could have probably found something better.

The hosts are very welcoming, it was nice to meet them. They helped us to bring our luggage up to the apartment. We were allowed to check-in earlier. Two big bottles of pretty good water were provided for us - thanks for that!
Unfortunately the apartment doesn't match the description. Places for sleeping differ in count and location. Everything is pretty old and has significant marks of usage. Many things are broken or partially broken (don't see how I can attach the photos here). We had issues with closing one of the windows. Wi-Fi connection is pretty bad, we spent some time trying to make it working. Hot water in the shower is very limited. I would say that the apartment fits max 4 people. Also it's worth to note that there is no elevator and the stairs is pretty narrow.

Don’t forget there’s an uphill walk to Galata Tower, but it’s very easy to reach Karaköy by going down a short staircase nearby — super convenient! The only downside is that there’s no elevator, and the apartment is on the top floor, so carrying luggage can be a bit hard. Just a small suggestion — adding a kitchen cleaning cloth, some paper towels, and a mop would be helpful. The terrace table wasn’t clean, but everything else was great. Having AC in every room and balconies opening from each one was fantastic. Thanks to the privacy film on the windows, you can keep the curtains open without being seen from outside.
The rooftop terrace inside the apartment has a breathtaking view — Galata Tower behind you, the Bosphorus and historic peninsula in front. The bed was large and comfy, and finding cold water in the fridge after a late-night arrival was a lovely touch. Çınar was super helpful and responsive. Highly recommend!✨

Çınar is absolutely the best Airbnb host I've ever met! This is the second place of his I stayed, and it was just as wonderful. This gorgeous flat is just like the photos. Bright, spacious, feels luxurious, and cozy even in winter. With heaters on it was perfectly warm even when snowing! Comfortable beds, sparkling clean rooms, warm water, and all the needed facilities for cooking, dining, storage, and even working remotely. The view from the rooftop is also breathtaking - I spent some sunny days with a book up there! And the location is perfect, near a small shop for essentials, near fabulous shops (check Galata Leather!), restaurants, coffee shops, and of course so close to Galata tower and the Galata bridge. Also, if you want food delivery the location is easy for this too! :) If you need anything at anytime, Çınar responds instantly and does everything he can to help. For example, there was a small electric break (city power issue) and within 30 minutes the electrician came and everything was fixed and perfectly normal - amazing. He also loaned me an umbrella because I didn't have one. He insisted I keep it for my travels but it's still available for the next lucky guest! Thank you for everything, Çınar!

description: it s small lovely studio flat (40 mt2) , only one room with two beds. and one bathroom. There is a swimming pool, fitness , steam room/sauna : charged daily 200 Turkish Liras per person. wifi internet unlimited and internet sattellit tv. there is security desk 24/hours and elevators and indoor car park. İt s near to Taksim-Beyoğlu 1 km. you can even walk there or take public buses/taxi.

reviews.text:
First off let me say that Mehmet was an amazing host; our stay was pleasant, safe, comfortable, quiet and very memorable.
We had some very minor problems at the beginning, which Mehmet helped us with posthaste and his communication was quick and friendly.
The location is great, just remember to go up the street when you get to Often Elesiyum Soul, as the downstairs is a Visa Centre and for the apartments you have to walk a little uphill, which takes 1 minute. The location is very close to Istiklal and Taksim Sq., but walking is a little uphill, but plenty of taxis and Ubers in the area. The building is very clean, modern with a nice garden, lovely staff and super quiet.
The apartment is very quiet; you can’t hear any neighbours. The garbage bin is in the fire exit area, which was right next door to our apartment and elevators were very prompt and close to our door.
The apartment has all the necessary kitchen appliances (Oven, microwave, kettle, sandwich maker, coffee maker, blender, etc.) as well as an easy-to-use washing machine, vacuum cleaner, iron, etc.
We didn’t get to use the TV, which I’m sure works perfectly but the internet was very comfortable to stream Netflix and FaceTime.
The room is very small, however for one person or a couple, it suffices; the bathroom is very spacious and perfect, the kitchen area is spacious enough to cook in and has all the pots, pans and cutlery one would need for making breakfast and dinner, as we did every day for a week. We bought some wine glasses and left them there for the next occupants and ourselves in the future but other than that, all the dishes and glassware were available in abundance!
Overall the apartment was pretty much perfect, had all the amenities, small and cute; we will definitely be staying again!
Thank you for your kindness and hospitality, we hope to see you again soon ☺️🙏🏼

My mom and brother stayed there for a month and below is their review; it was pleasant because it was safe, clean, and quiet. The Internet was good as I played games online. The location is good, but to go to Taksim square, you have to walk uphill, so it’s hard. Check-in and check-out without any problem. However, there were two points that we were not satisfied with. The first one is that the bedsheets, blankets, pillow cases and towels where really old and worn out. Moreover, the cookware such as pans and pots were used many times with so many scratched and therefore unhealthy to use.

An excellent place! Mehmet is a great person: great communication, very punctual, responsive, and generous. My whole stay went very smooth from the get-go. The studio may seem small at first, but it’s just perfect. It is fully equipped. Amazing air conditioning for both heating and cooling... with totally silent AC fan and wall heating radiators. The building is also excellent. Safe, quite, and well located. Close to all. I highly recommend this place to solo travelers, couples, and even those with a child. Thank you Mehmet for hosting me!

place is great
location is very good and near to taksim also very quite as its inside lux residence
pool , steam room , gym and sauna is fine too
Internet was good as I was working from home
room had everything you would need (kitchen wise & cleaning and laundry wise )
last but not least Mr Mehmet is very kind and decent and was able to help me resolve any issues I faced

Check-in and check-out was without any problem! Flat is pretty close to the İstiklal Caddesi and subway (15-20 minutes to Şişhane station). I think it could be the one of comfortable option in the area. I would recommend it to anyone who would like to stay in this place! I would also like to mention the hospitality of the host.

description:
Featuring an unparalleled location, the house is a 10-metre walk from Galata Tower and a 5-minute walk from the Metro Tram and bus stops. The apartment has a well-appointed bedroom, living room and bathroom, all featuring modern fixtures and amenities. The large rooftop terrace is shared with another unit.
Please note that because this is a historic property under protected status there is no elevator in the building.

reviews.text:
It was one of the best Airbnb experience for me: apartments were amazing – clean, modern and cozy and has everything you need for the stay. Location is quiet despite the fact that it's really close to the Galata tower. And the view from the terrace is just breathtaking – the morning coffee has never been better.
Neriman is an amazing host, she was communicative and always ready to help.

Neriman was a really great host, very kind and always available. The flat is very well located near the Galata tower. Moreover, the rooftop on the building is probably one of the best in Istanbul. I highly recommend this airbnb !!

Fantastic place, Neriman was very accommodating and made us feel very welcome. One thing to keep in mind is that the terrace, while absolutely fantastic, is up on the roof of a 6(7?) story building with no elevator.
Would come back!
Absolutely recommended! Cozy apartment with nice details and central location. Neriman has been very welcoming, definitely a great host.

Super experience in a historical area with a super host available 24/7 to help and answer any question. The flat is a very modern in aquite street with 2 bathrooms and living room. Terrace is a separate stories we will never forget our breakfasts in motningabd glass of wine in evening with an outstanding view.

description:
Apartment is fully furnished and equipped with all stuff you need during your stay. Its located at the main street of Taksim Square. Taksim square is also common station for all public transports.

Our apartment is historical and we have ELEVATOR. Flat has partial sea view and Taksim Square view that you can enjoy taste of Istanbul.

Flat is luxury furnished as 2 bedrooms and 1 living room.

1st Bedroom has 1 King Size Bed
2nd Bedroom has 2 Separate Single Beds.
Living Room has 1 Sofabed

reviews.text:
Pros:
Host is responsive and helpful
Location is great
Cons:
The place needs serious maintenance. Leaking water in the Bathroom, so many missing items in the kitchen, not enough things to make a decent meal. Terrible pots and pans. Water getting cold after 5 minutes(both morning and nights). Broken chair (which I almost felt down because of it). Not comfortable mattress for double bed. Not enough soap, toilet papers, trash bags etc. (Host provided them after a day but we had to buy anyways)
Small elevator which was not working once and we had to climb up 5 floors with a baby.
It is too expensive, they are charging people that much and don’t spend even a bit of it to buy some kitchenwares. Be aware: U are only paying for the location.

Best apartment ever in the center of Istanbul . Centrally located in front of gezi park overlooking the taksim square amazing view from the balcony , the most luxurious apartment I have ever seen in Istanbul , fully furnished comfortable and clean spacious for a family secured for your safety with main building door and elevator working with card , you can go anywhere you want in istanbul within minutes only from this location , so friendly host thanks to Mrs Nur & Mr Ibrahiem , I am looking forward to book in the same apartment again on my next trip

I stayed with my family for 6 days
The apartment was absolutely amazing same as in pictures very close to taksim and estaklel street very comfortable and we felt like home
The location is near metro bus very easy to go anywhere from there
Big thanks to ahmed our host he was amazing super approachable replays to anything in few minutes
Look forward to come back soon

We had a wonderful stay here for a week. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The rooms were spacious, and the view was beautiful. Everything we needed was provided, and we felt at home throughout our stay. We were all very pleased with our experience and would definitely recommend this place to others. Thank you for being a great host!

This place was outstanding.
I never was in a place clean and spacious like this.
There was no problems during our stay and even minor questions were replied less than a 5 minutes 24/7.
This place has got a astonishing view which makes it exceptional. You have the view over the beautiful part of Bosphorous channel in Istanbul and also Taksim square.
There is no heels for accessing the house and my old parents could easily walk to the house and use the elevator.
All in all, I want to say thanks Ahmed and Nur as you are brilliant hosts!

description: Stay in the heart of Çukurcuma, one of Istanbul's most charming and historic neighborhoods, just a short walk from Galata, Cihangir, Karaköy, and İstiklal Street. Hosted by Homie Suites, this stylish one-bedroom apartment offers seamless self check-in, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, and everything you need for a comfortable stay. Surrounded by antique shops, art galleries, cafés, and local restaurants, you'll experience one of Istanbul's most authentic neighborhoods.

reviews.text:
Our one-month stay was literally amazing and beyond our expectations! Everything we needed was there and luxurious.
The location is very central near Public transport in a very safe and calm area of Cihangir (in less than 10 min by walking you can reach Taksim Square or Istiklal Street). Furthermore, plenty of magnificent cafés and designer locol stores were in a proximity to the apartment.
The host was so kind to provide us with an oven and desk to work from home as we requested before check-in.
the kitchen is superclean, modern and well equipped with brand-new cooking appliances. The dishwasher was so good.
The bedroom was so comfy, the wardrobe was spacious with multiple shelves to tide up everything clearly.
Regarding the living room, We liked the idea that it is connected to the kitchen so my wife can cook while I am chatting with her and watching TV.
The sun light enters the apartment from each side which is something very important for us.
The host cared a lot about the details, the TV was also connected with an Apple TV as well as a NETFLIX subscription!
As the apartment contained everything, the host also provided us with housekeeping service every week to make sure everything is kept bright and clean during our stay as well as changing all the towels and linens with white superclean new ones every week.
Finally, I would like to thank Gizem and Eren for their kind support and fast replies, they helped us with everything we've asked them about.
I highly recommend this place for short and long term bookings. We definitely will book this place again when we are in Istanbul next time.

All 5/5.
Excellent location, great renovated building with elevator, new and fully equipped apartment.
Comfortable sofa and bed, great kitchen and even the small table which is perfect for work on a laptop. The host is always available and helps with all requests.
100% recommended.

Eren place is at a perfect location, very easy to get around with public transportation and walking distance to awsome bars and restaurants. The apartment was great, very clean and has everything you need. Pictures on the internet do not do this property justice wow factor. Location was fab. Eren and Gizem were also very helpful since the beginning, available at all times whenever I had any questions. Totally recommend it.

Excellent stay. Place matched the photos and the description. Very clean.
Quiet neighborhood, but still walkable to busy places. Everything is nearby.
Host is very responsive and helpful. Any issues that were present were fixed and at tried to get fixed right away. Morning major. Overall very satisfied.

High quality apartment with a separate bedroom and bathroom and nice finishes. The apartment was quiet and comfortable. Easy and secure access via the elevator to the third level flat. The hospitality provided by Mete and Tunc was outstanding - responsive, professional and attentive. This apartment is located on the "antique" street in the Cihangir neighborhood, which is a very good location. It was easy to walk to the nearby shops and restaurants in the surrounding and desirable Cihangir neighborhood.

description: Our place, which is very close to Taksim Square and located on the upper street of Istiklal Avenue, is a very good option for those looking for an economical, clean and safe place. Our room has one large bed for 2 people. There is Wi-Fi, a wardrobe, TV, air conditioner and a kettle for tea and coffee. There is a central heating system and 24-hour hot water. There are many markets, restaurants and shopping malls near us.

reviews.text:
Yer biraz ufak ama tam bir fiyat performans odası :) kış günü tshirt ile uyudum. sıcak suda da sorun yaşamadığım nadir yerlerden. havlular da temizdi, Ferhat bey ilgiliydi. Tim soruları hızlı cevapladı. Tekrar tercih edeceğim biryer.
Rooms are a bit small but it is perfect for it's price. It was super hot inside, have been able to sleep with tshirt in the middle of winter. I havent had any problem in bathroom as well, hot water is stable which is very important for me. And towels were clean and soft. Mr Ferhat was always helpfull with the questions and kind. I will stay here again.

Overpriced, dirty, host didn’t seem to care when I asked about the missing amenities (wifi, Air Conditioning, etc.) . Mold in bathroom, dirty towels with stains, hair and dust in the bed, the refrigerator didn’t work. Stay somewhere else.

Location was very convenient, just steps away from Istiklal Street and minutes away from Taksim Square. Checked-in for a quick shower and rest - the room was perfect for it. Even though the room is on the smaller side, the bed was comfortable. Shower was leaking though, water seeped out of the enclosed shower area onto the bathroom floor - could be dangerous as it was very slippery.
Superb location if you search something near the Taksim Place. The host is very friendly, the apartment is small, but clean, comfortable and has everything you need. Thumbs up!
The host is very supportive. The unit is very close to Taqsim square and it is a safe place to stay. The unit was clean, although small but comfortable.

description:
This Deluxe room with a balcony in Büyükada Çınar Hotel has a view overlooking the street on the 2nd floor. There is a mini fridge, bathroom and TV unit in the room.
*Each individual must provide identification at the entrance to the facility. No one under the age of 19 is accepted.

reviews.text: Oda fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Giriş yaparken bir zorluk yaşamadık ve kibar karşılandık. Bavulumuzu taşımamıza yardımcı oldu ve giriş çıkışlarda bir eksiğimiz olup olmadığını sordu. Kendisinin kibar ve anlayışlı bir üslubu vardı. Oda temizdi eşyalar temizdi. tatlı küçük ve iki kişi için yeterli bir balkonu var. Oda içerisinde televizyon buz dolabı ve su ısıtıcı vardı. sorunsuz çalışıyordu. havlular ve tek kullanımlık terlikler de biz gitmeden önce hazırlanmıştı. Konumu itibariyle de oldukça işlevsel bir işletme. Dışarı çıktığınızda her şey hemen elinizin altında. Özelden işletme sahibine iyileştirilmesini talep ettiğim bir kaç konu oldu. banyo giderinden gelen koku ara ara rahatsız ediciydi. banyoda kıyafetlerimi asabileceğim bir askıya ihtiyaç duydum. tüm bunları değerlendirdiğimizde kalmayı tekrar isteyeceğim bir yer. genel olarak memnun ayrıldık. fiyatı temizliği konumu bizim için avantajlar sundu. tekrar görüşmek üzere diyelim :)

Well where do I start. From the moment we walked into Muemmers ‘Airbnb’ we were met with an unwelcoming attitude from the receptionist (I don’t know if that was Muemmer or someone else). I said ‘Merhaba’ as I walked in, he told me to shut the door behind me. I said ‘Merhaba’ again, he told me to wear my mask. Both times not acknowledging that we are guests and a simple hello would have been nice.
He then asked for our passports…me and my wife have been staying in Istanbul for nearly 2 months now in 2 different Airbnb’s. Both hosts did not ask us for our passport when checking in. We know hotels require passports (if you book with them online) but this was on Airbnb, it didn’t say on the ad that passport+HES code check in is required like any other hotel, we assumed he would treat us like any other host on Airbnb. It was no problem as I had my passport and HES and my wife her copies on her phone, she just needed time to find it and show it…but instead he started shouting at us asking why we don’t have our passports and that it will be a big problem with police. This took us by shock as all he had to do was be calm and explain to us kindly that this is like other hotel bookings not normal Airbnb hosting. Instead he proceeded to shout at my wife, which made me defensive and argue back pleading with him to stop shouting and be respectful. He then started swearing under his breath in Turkish thinking we don’t understand.
He didn’t treat us like a guest, he made us feel like we were criminals. He should have behaved like a host who could have explained things to us in a calm way. He said we can both leave and he would refund us money but then refused to cancel the trip on Airbnb asking us to cancel it. If we had cancelled, we wouldn’t have got our money back because of his no-refund policy.
In the end we had no choice but to stay, it was only for one night and it was really cold and late, my wife sent him her passport photo and HES code, all this arguing and unnecessary reaction for saying we don’t have hard copy
of passport, to only be sent the right details and let us stay the night. He finally gave us the keys, but then minutes later started banging on our door saying we gave him fake passport details. How did we get into Turkey with fake British passport? It was so absurd and the worst experience of my life staying somewhere. He totally ruined our trip, we even got paranoid he would do something if we left our belongings in the room so we took our bags with us when going out.
The room itself was good, it had mould on the walls and in the night it was very cold. Balcony was nice but in all honesty, we just wanted to get out of there. Our trip was ruined.
Please be kind to your guests, you don’t understand how much we were looking forward to our trip, we rushed work and travelled 3 hours for this trip and we was so tired with all our luggage, you truly ruined our trip as we woke up just wanting to check out as fast as we could.
This is an honest review, I apologise for the long details but it’s important people know the treatment we received, we have no idea why he had this attitude with us, as we checked the reviews before we came and they were all positive. If you had checked our reviews as guests, you would know we make an effort with every airbnb we try go to and are very considerate guests. What a shame.

Muammar's place is ideally located, only 5 mins walk from the ferry. It's spacious and has a nice balcony. Comfortable bed and warm shower. Warm and cosy in the Winter, when I was there (in fact, I had to open the window, it was so warm). Muammar was friendly. He owns another hotel, so is not on site, but nearby. Good value for money.

Oda fotoğrafın aynısıydı, yatak banyo temizdi. 2 kişi kalmak için ideal bir yer. Konum zaten harika .heryere rahatşıkla ulaşabilirsinz. Muammer Bey bize içtenlklr yardımcı oldu. Tekrar tercih edeceğiz teşekkürler🌸☺️
fiyat/performans konaklaması. Fotoğraflardaki gibi. Temiz. Konumu çok güzel.

description: Discover one of Cihangir's most exceptional stays in this beautifully renovated one-bedroom apartment with a spacious private rooftop terrace overlooking Istanbul's iconic skyline. Hosted by Homie Suites, enjoy panoramic views of Topkapı Palace, Sultanahmet, the Historic Peninsula, and Galata Tower, just a short walk from Taksim Square, İstiklal Street, Galata, and Karaköy

reviews.text:
Great location with stunning views from the terrace. The host was responsive, and the early check-in was much appreciated.
There is, however, a big but - the terrace is a major selling point of the apartment. Having read reviews from previous guests regarding the upkeep and condition of the furniture, I contacted the host beforehand to ensure that the issues previously raised had been addressed.
I was therefore greatly disappointed to arrive and find tired, dirty furniture, missing sofa cushions, and a sun umbrella that has seen better days.
It was also surprising to find the toilet seat hanging off its hinges when the host knew they had a guest arriving.
To the host’s credit, they promptly arranged for the toilet seat to be fixed and for two men to secure the umbrella in a fixed position.
I’d recommend either replacing the furniture, or reducing the price and updating the listing with current photos so that potential guests can make a fully informed decision before booking.

We had an amazing stay at Homie Suits. The first thing that draw us to this property was the view from the terrace. We didn’t find anything else like it in Istambul and it didn’t dissapoint!
The flat feels safe, it was spotless clean and is comes with well equiped kitchen and has loads of storage. It has a lift which was very helpful to carry bags. The host kindly agreed to add an extra bed for me (I was travelling with my Mum) and also provided extra towels.
All very confirtable and felt like new linen.
The host was very responsive and professional, and checkin/checkout was very smooth.
It is conveniently located near Istklal street from where you can easily access public transport and many restaurants. Just bear in mind it’s a very busy street and at weekends you can hear music all night.
The terrace furniture looked a bit weathered and in need of a refresh. But really this the only thing it could be improved. Everything else was perfect!
We highly recommend it!

The location is great, the neighbourhood is lively and beautiful, clean and safe. Can be noisy at night, not soundproofed.
The service was also fantastic, fast reply and eager and quick to help. I was able to check in earlier which was a great help and was able to safely store my luggage after check out before leaving for the airport.
The apartment is comfortable and it is nice having the outdoor space (on both sides!). Enough space for one person but a little smaller than it looks in pictures. It is very charming and has amazing views. I missed basic supplies such as dishwasher tablets, hand soap, sugar, and salt.
The apartment definitely needs some maintenance and updating inside and outside. The outdoor furniture is completely weathered and therefore a bit dirty and uncomfortable. The umbrella is broken and torn and unusable making the terrace too hot to sit during the day. It is a shame they do not fix this as the terrace is the selling point of this apartmen

First and foremost, the views are incredible; you are treated to possibly the most expansive panoramic view over Istanbul to enjoy sunsets whilst enjoying the vast terrace.
The home is very comfortable, modern and clean. High-quality linens in the bedroom, very spacious with loads of storage space, the bedroom is street facing with a lovely balcony too.
The kitchen is fully equipped with state-of-the-art appliances and everything you need to cook meals should you decide to stay in. Although we recommend experiencing as many restaurants as possible, you are spoilt for choice.
The location was perfect, with easy walking distance to Taksim and access to the Bosphorus. You are surrounded by bars, cafes and restaurants to keep you entertained, and when you need a break from Turkish food, you have Az Cok Thai on your doorstep; it is impressive.
Your hosts are very attentive and easy to communicate, making sure your stay is perfect. You won’t be disappointed.

The place is in a very central location - a trendy hipster place. As everyone said, the views from the terrace are just amazing - especially at night when everything is lit up. The communication was smooth and easy and the self check-in feature is so easy. The apartment was exactly in the pictures and the building had a lift ! A blessing
Some things can be made better - the bed is very springy, I was uncomfortable and the furniture in the balcony/terrace has seen better days. A refresh may help

description:
My Apartment is centrally located in oldtown, just 5 min. walk to Sultanahmet Square & Hippodrome also historic attractions.

Duru Sultanahmet Apart & Suites: our apart hotel, your home.
If comfort and hygiene is your red line, then Duru Sultanahmet is your place to stay. Our name Duru, stands for pure and clear in Turkish, and we chose our name for a reason. In these times, where hygiene is more important than ever, our mission is to provide its guests a comfortable and safe place so stay.

reviews.text: Excellent location, great staff and airport transfer services. The appartement looks like in the photos, but definitely needs some improvements, especially on the bed linings, the WC and the shower. There where some marks on the bed linings and not as clean as I would expected. I would definitely recommend it after some improvements in order to reflect the price.

Mr. Younus and Furqan were great hosts. The location is great with all attractions nearby and lively restaurants and cafes open till late night. Furqan was very courteous in guiding us about our Turkey trip.
Apartment was super clean, heating was spot on and everything as the photos suggest. Highly recommend.

Pros:
• Great location to restaurants, shops and tourist attractions.
• Ercan & Yunus were friendly, responsive and although we didn’t take up their options they do provide airport transfers, restaurant recommendations and activities.
• Bed was quite comfortable for two pp. (King Size)
• Room felt secure with their door system.
• Room had all the necessary essentials.
Cons:
• The toilet / bathroom did not match the photos on the airbnb, our shower area was much smaller since there seems to be a down pipe within the cavity wall right besides the shower head. It is important to note it does make some noise from the water discharge from the above floors from time to time however not for long would say 30 secs - 1 min in random times of the day. Not sure with Turkish construction standards but usually these pipes in habitable spaces would be insulated to prevent / reduce such noise.

Pros
Great location, easy to walk to restaurants, Hagia Sofia, Blue Mosque etc.
Clean and tidy
Host was communicative, gave us recommendations if we wanted them.
Cons
Rooms were very hot, we did manage to turn the radiators down which helped.
If you rely on a hairdryer I'd perhaps bring your own. There is one provided but it's attached to the wall in the bathroom and isn't very strong.
Overall a good value apartment in a central location.

Great little apartment stay just on the edge of the “ tourist “ circle where main sites are located in the very high tourist section of Istanbul , comfortable bed/ lounge and happily supplied extra sheet and doona when we asked . Bathroom needs a deep clean and be aware it’s located down a steep hill if your mobility is challenged, kitchenette with no stove top but many restaurants are close by ( be ready for the annoying touts vying for business ) overall a great stay .

description: If you are bored with the noisy European side and want to stay in a calm, spiritual but at the same time vibrant place, you found it! Moreover you are still amazingly close to all the touristic spots of the city. We offer you a brand new 1+1 flat with lovely flowers, bamboo furnitures and cozy vibes. In Uskudar you can live Istanbul beyond the surface and experience culture in real life. Moreover we are here to assist your journey :))!

reviews.text:
Overall we had an ok stay at the apartment during our month-long stay.
Positives:
-Emrah was quite responsive and welcomed us when we arrived late due to a flight delay
-The neighborhood is very peaceful and you have groceries nearby (but be ready to climb up some stairs)
-You have a functioning kitchen, bathroom, and a nice TV
Room for Improvement:
-The apartment was not cleaned thoroughly upon our arrival (moldy food left in fridge, clothes hanging to dry still outside, closet was over half full with the owner's stuff (inconvenient when we were a couple staying for over a month and needing that space)
-The bed is quite small for a couple and not firm (I ended up sleeping in the couch because two people do not comfortably fit)
-There is no AC or fan (it got quite hot in July due to the humidity)
-There is no desk for working/studying
If you're going for a short stay, the apartment probably meets your needs just fine but for a longer stay for more than one person may be not ideal

Emrah's place is in a great part of Üsküdar , close to downtown. It is a nice quiet family neighborhood, and just a short walk to the center, old town and the Bazar. The apartment is also very convenient for grocery stores and restaurants (all takeaway when we were staying, because of Covid restrictions). The kitchen in the flat is well equipped, and we could cook our food easily .There were enough plates, pots and pans, mugs and glasses. The flat is nicely furnished and very clean. There are two heaters, one in the living room (which is also the kitchenand dining area) and another in the bedroom. In October it does a little cold, so the heating was really welcome in this moment and Evenings. Istanbul Üsküdar is a great town to visit, and we had a lovely time. I highly recommend this stay for comfort, cleanliness, hospitality and peaceful sleep. Fast Internet was + ! Emrah is so nice host and very hopeful to advise many restaurants and always responding to our messages fastly. I recommend this place for the people who are looking for peacefully stay in Istanbul.
La place d'Emrah se trouve dans une grande partie d'Üsküdar, à proximité du centre-ville. C'est un joli quartier familial et calme, à quelques pas du centre, de la vieille ville et du Bazar. L'appartement est également très pratique pour les épiceries et les restaurants (tous à emporter lors de notre séjour, à cause des restrictions Covid). La cuisine de l'appartement est bien équipée et nous pouvions cuisiner facilement. Il y avait suffisamment d'assiettes, de casseroles et de poêles, de tasses et de verres. L'appartement est joliment meublé et très propre. Il y a deux radiateurs, un dans le salon (qui est aussi la cuisine et coin repas) et un autre dans la chambre. En octobre il fait un peu froid, donc le chauffage était vraiment le bienvenu en ce moment et en soirée. Istanbul Üsküdar est une ville formidable à visiter et nous avons passé un très bon moment. Je recommande vivement ce séjour pour le confort, la propreté, l'accueil et le sommeil paisible. Internet rapide était plus que parfait. Emrah est un hôte très sympathique et a bon espoir de conseiller de nombreux restaurants et de toujours répondre rapidement à nos messages. Je recommande cet endroit pour les personnes qui recherchent un séjour paisible à Istanbul.

Had a great time at Emrah's place. The place is exactly as listed and better than the pictures. The apartment was ver clean without a spec of dirt anywhere. The location is close to several attractions - Kuzguncuk about 15 to 20 mins walking, Üsküdar ferry about 10 to 15 mind walking. The public bus stop and marmaray stations are als close by.
The WiFi was not working on the first day of check-in. The problem was with the provider. Emrah kept following up with the service provider and Internet wad restored the next morning.
Emrah met us at the apartment, and check-in went smoothly.
The small kitchen is very well equipped. You can prepare meals if required. But there are some excellent eating places nearby so we did not cook at home.
We also had a small hiccup with getting in the apartment late one evening. Emrah helped us late at night and one of the neighbours let us in.
Highly recommended for couples or small families. Would like to come again.
Thank you Emrah. You are a 5 star host.

Emrah was a very easygoing and responsive host. His place is best suited for one person or two smaller people due to the bed size. However, the sofa is also a possibility. The flat is located in the ground floor so there are people coming nearby but I was positively surprised no one was looking inside. The metal grit on the window attributes to the feeling of safety. The washing and coffee machine are of great advantage. On our first night (from Friday to Saturday morning) there was loud traffic so ear buds were very helpful but all the other nights were calm.

Very nice apartment clean, comfortable and great location
Easy to communicate with the host
Has everything you need.
Very close to the public transportation. Highly recommend it to stay.

description: Our apartment, which is in the same building as the hotel, is up-to-date and has a unique sea view from the bedroom and living room. Wifi is available. Our pool is available for an extra fee.

reviews.text:
I would only stay here again if improvements are made.
The location is OK, nice environment with the hotel downstairs, but please understand this apartment is actually in Ottomare Suites which is on one of the floors of the same building as Radisson Blue. The staff at Radisson Blu will not know anything about your booking. You need to go to floor 0 and not the Radisson Blu hotel reception.
When you leave the area i found that taxi drivers did not want to come back to this area to bring you back from wherever you are in Istanbul. However, the location of this apartment has good metro links.
There is a really nice place nearby with lots of cool restaurants. Its called Fişkehane and you can walk to it from the apartment. No need for a taxi.
The apartment has wifi ask the owner for the code if this information is not given beforehand or on arrival.
I made a few other recommendations to the owner to do with cleanliness in the apartment and some minor repairs, if these are taken on board this is not a bad place to stay. Good luck!

Can Bey ile uzaktan iletişim ile tüm giriş-çıkış sürecimiz anlaşılır ve kolay idi.

description: The apartment building has a special location in the city, close to trade and shopping centers (Trump Towers and Cevahir mall), banks, cinemas, theaters and art centers. You can easily reach E5, one of the main transportation routes in Istanbul, metro and metrobus. Our facility has a washing machine, kitchen, microwave, oven, air conditioning, smart TV and refrigerator. Among the amenities offered are free Wi-Fi access and free parking.

reviews.text: I thought I had rented an apartment flat on airbnb and was not very happy to find out it’s actually a tiny ‘hotel room’. There is a reception desk when you enter the building and they take a copy of your ID just like in a hotel. Yes the photos are accurate but the flat is smaller than it looks in the photos. The location is not the best, its almost in Kuştepe which has a bad reputation for drug dealers etc, it is not a totally safe town. But still the hotel is a fortunately close to Trump’s shopping mall. The lobby was crowded with foreign guests waiting for their rooms to be ready for the check-in. The hotel room I rented was totally clean but still had a bad smell after I took a shower. I asked for an extra half an hour before the check-out and Osman told me that the next guest felt sick and I should immediately leave the room. Thats reasonable because he doesnt have to give me extra time, every place has its own rules on airbnb and that’s totally fine with me. But I ran out to the next guest while waiting for a cab and she was totally fine and talking on the phone with laughters. I just didnt like that I was lied to, I can’t say it’s such a professional attitude. I wouldnt recommend this hotel room in the first place but it has some extra services for the foreign guests and it would be more enjoyable for those who need those services which many hotels dont provide. Thanks Osman anyway, he did his best about the communication and was polite to us.

Ailem ile birlikte bir gece konakladık. Odalar ve banyo temizdi. Evimiz gibi rahat bir gece gece geçirdik. Konakladiğimiz yer olarak metroya çok yakındı. Trump tower hemen yanında. Araç park sorunu yaşamadık. Osman bey gayet ilgili bir işletmeci, Tekrar İstanbula gelirsek ilk tercihimiz olacaktır.

reviews.text: It was a comfortable and clean stay, easy and straightforward check-in. Rezeq was always friendly, helpful and responsive. The area has many Cafés and restaurants nearby. If you have a car, it might get a bit challenging to find a parking spot in front of the building. All in all, a great experience and fully recommended!

Mohannad was an amazing and kind host. He was available for anything we needed him for. We had an issue with the key that broke into the lock and she showed up within 10 minutes to fix the issue. The place is amazingly clean , modern and it is bigger and more spacious than the pictures. It has all amenities, we enjoyed the gym and outdoor rooftop pool so much. The location is one of the kind. It is accessible, close to everything you may need during your stay. From cafe to convenient store, drug store ,... Taxies always parking right there to use. All and all, it was an amazing experience staying at this place, I and my family loved it ! Highly recommend it.

We had an amazing stay at the apartment. Everything was as described and more. Everything was clean and spotless. The view was nice and the host was even better. Mohannad was very responsive and proactive. Helped us with suggestions, invited us over to his place for a very delicious dinner and took time out of his day to drive us somewhere to get food late night when everything else was closed near us. I will be booking again next time I come to Istanbul!

description: Enjoy luxury and comfort in a historical building in Beyoğlu. It will be very pleasant to watch the city lights and the fascinating view of the harbor in our spacious apartment.

reviews.text: The appartement is exactly as shown on the photos. It is even bigger than expected, especially the bedroom, which has a wonderful view. There is enough storage space in the bedroom as well as in the living room, the entire flat is clean, new and very modern furnished. Everthing like TV, WiFi, heaters work very well, only the kitchen is a bit smaller compared to the rest, but for a few days stay ok and good equipped with dishes. The whole building is also new with an elevator, it is located in a central, quiet and safe, but not that appealing looking neighbourhood, there are a few small supermarkets right next door where you can find everything necessary, and it is only a short 10min walk to Istiklal street. The price/quality ratio of the whole accommodation is absolutely good and the appartement can really be recommend. The hosts are always there (reception in the house) if you have any questions, and can also be reached by message at any time.

The apartment was as described; very clean and comfortable, walking distance to Taksim square. We enjoyed our stay and communication was great with host. Security in lobby also good. Elevator is good. Only recommendation I would like to make - the drying rack is clearly broken so that made drying clothes a bit difficult but we figured it out. Overall would recommend!

Very cozy place with good heating system. Right outside you have a cute bakery and a few markets. 6 minutes walk to bus station and walkable distance to Taksim/Galata if you enjoy walking.
The bedroom has an amazing window view, you could see some big mosque lights while you are laying in bed.
The only downside was the outside noise but it wasn’t so bad.
Still worth the price, and the host was amazing. We had a water heater problem and within 2 minutes someone showed up at our door to fix it.
I would stay again

We stayed at NM Suites Beyoğlu for three days and had a great experience from start to finish. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped,. The location is excellent with easy access to shops, restaurants, and main attractions.
Communication was smooth and efficient, and the host was very helpful and responsive throughout our stay. Check-in was easy, and everything was exactly as described.
Overall, everything was great, and we would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul. We would happily stay here again.

The apartment is far smaller than the photos make it appear. The living-room window overlooks the garbage containers of the surrounding buildings, so forget about opening it for fresh air—unless your idea of fresh air is the smell of everyone’s trash.
There is only one small air-conditioning unit, located in the bedroom, which is somehow expected to cool the entire apartment. Unsurprisingly, it couldn’t even cool the bedroom itself, let alone the rest of the place.
I arrived exhausted at around 1:00 a.m. and contacted the host the following morning to report the problem. His response was simply that it was Sunday, I should wait another day, and he would do nothing about it.
At that point, I requested to cancel my stay, yet I was still charged for two nights after spending only around 10 miserable hours in this tiny, unbearably hot, foul-smelling apartment.

description:
Brand new refurbished condo in the heart of Istanbul. Only top quality products and brands are used in this cozy house.A well-designed flat that contains everything you need.
This condo is in the center of Istanbul an exciting quarter of Beşiktaş with museums, restaurants, shops etc.

After an exciting day, you can take a deep rest in the silent bedroom with a balcony, visiting the most exciting places of Istanbul, nearby!

This place's three magical words are Location, Quality, and Confidence.

reviews.text: We had a great stay at Cem's place. The apartment is located in a popular spot with a lot of restaurants, shops, and all possible things within walking distance. The rooms are clean and comfortable, and look the way they are in the pictures. Cem helped us with our luggage and with finding a parking slot. He also suggested good and inexpensive restaurants around.

Cem was very helpful and responsive. The apartment was as described very quiet, clean and well furnished. Well located in Beşiktaş with the grocery shops, supermarkets, restaurants and coffee shops are all very close. If you like walking then you can get to many popular places close by and all types of transportation is also available. The wifi is excellent.
I booked it for 2 weeks but I had to leave after 1 week due to personal matters back home. Since I can't get refund for the 2nd week Cem offered me a free week whenever i visit Istanbul again! Thank you Cem! you are great 👍
This place is highly recommended.

Everything at Cem’s place was absolutely as described, it was also impeccably clean. It felt like a new apartment. We felt comfortable and right at home. Location was also great, close to public transport and streets full of life. Communication with Cem was easy and he was always helpful and accommodating. Would definitely recommend.

Without doubt a very positive experience.
The apartment is new and clean, and it has everything you need for a comfortable stay. All around it you can find many shops and places to eat, just by walking a few minutes. It's close to Beşiktaş Meydan, where you can take several buses to go to other areas of Istanbul; and also close to the ferry stations, which proved to be an effective and nice way to move around.
Cem is a wonderful host, very kind and accommodating.

I had a fantastic stay for a few days at Cem’s apartment. His brother was waiting for me when I arrive to let me into the apartment and show me the place. Communication was always prompt. The place itself was very clean, and fairly spacious. The shower and laundry machine work well, and the kitchen looked well equipped. The apartment is a 3rd story walk up. The neighborhood is energetic, with lots of restaurants and bars around, but the apartment itself is quiet. Internet was fairly stable in the main room, a few slowdowns during video calls for work, but no drops. Both Cem and his brother were great, and I definitely recommend their place!

description: This is a cozy private room with the bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 5-6 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City. Also, we have a 24/7 front desk agent to assist you with anything you might need.

reviews.text: It was actually a hotel with very satisfying price! we did not see Kamil there, but his staffs were really nice and polite to us. Our communication was great as he answered in a very short time after we asked questions. When we arrived they didn't make the bed as double bed as we wanted, but they changed it afterwards and even offer us any room if we weren't satisfied. But we didn't want to change the room cause the room is lovely as it is already. The breakfast was great with an astonishing view. The room was cleaned every day and even the cleaning staffs were very friendly. We couldn't ask for better room or price in Istanbul. Thank you!

We didn’t meet Kamil since he manage another Hostels but the service was very nice and helpful.
I just stay one night in Istanbul and we got all the necessary information from the staff working in the reception.
The room was amazing with the lovely views to the sea and from the balcony in the breakfast area views to the Blue Mosque, clean and nice for the price.
The location is perfect and quiet during the night, in the city centre and easy to find it coming with public transport from the airport.
I would definitively recommend the B&B and for sure I will choose when I will be back to Istanbul.

We had a very nice stay here. It's in a quiet area, nice neighborhood and very close to the main sights. We didn't see Kamil, but he'd arranged for an airport pick-up and staff at the guest house were very welcoming. The room was as pictured, clean and with a good mattress. We enjoyed a delicious self-serve breakfast on the top floor with a nice view from the terrace.
The hotel is well located and clean. The staff were very helpful. I highly recommend it

It was very nice experience staying at Kamil's hotel, the people who working in are very gentle and friendly especially Hakan who was very helpful guy.
The place are near every thing and the room was very nice and clean with wonderful sea view.

description:
Brand new renovated historical building offers cozy appartments in Cihangir
The building is a recently renovated, historical building. It is located at Cihangir neighbourhood, one of Istanbul's oldest bohemian districts in Beyoğlu. Sunflower Apartments is 100m from a neighbourhood with many narrow streets, a park, grocery shops, cafés and restaurants. It is located within a walking distance from Taksim Square/metro, Beşiktaş, Pera, Galataport Karaköy and Nisantasi.

reviews.text:
We had a pleasant stay at Elif''s. Host was very responsive and Soner answered any questions we had any time of the day or night. Place is close to shops, restaurants, Taksim Square and metro.
Apt was neat and tidy and just like the pictures. A quiet, private lift to the apartment was a bonus.
Host offered pick up from the airport at extra cost, it was really helpful.
We took a one bed apartment and enjoyed our stay.
Bathroom as many said is very small but good for 2 people on a short stay.
Suggestions: I would suggest having a mirror with shelf outside or in the bedroom.
A table fan or a ceiling fan is a must for hot days as an alternative.
One night our AC refused to work. Thankfully it wasn't too hot so we managed. Soner was very kind to offer us another apartment but we were leaving the next day so we declined. The host provided us a drop off to the airport as a kind gesture for the inconvenience. Recommend this place.

Beautiful, spacious apartment in a great area of Istanbul - we stayed here for 11 days & thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. Soner was very helpful & always there to answer any questions we had in person & via Whatapp. The apartment had everything we needed, was clean & the bed is comfortable.
Taksim, Karakoy, Nisantasi along with other popular areas of Istanbul are all walking distance from the apartment, there is a supermarket on the door step along with cafes & restaurants, location is amazing!
The other negatives were the bathroom is very small and the tv didn’t have Netflix as described but overall, a great place to stay!
Thank you ✨

Pros:
Great location, very walkable.
Friendly and responsive host.
Bedroom is back from the street so not as much street noise.
Apartment is in an alley within an alley so it’s quite relaxed given the proximity to the chaos.
Furnished nicely and looks like the photos.
Cons:
Elevator opens directly into the room, which was surprisingly unsettling.
There’s a lot of neighbour noise, especially from above, but also whenever anyone uses the elevator.
Soap isn’t included, it’s the first time I’ve ever had to buy my own soap on holiday.
Extremely small bathroom.

Great place, super clean, great location, lovely welcome especially from Osman, what a legend. Bathroom in this room is very narrow so if you’re a wide person you might struggle but it wasn’t a problem for us. Internet was good too and the bed really comfy.

This is a very cozy and bright apartment just a few minutes' walk from Taksim Square. It's convenient to get to the nearest attractions such as Istiklal Street, as well as to Galataport (or the historical center). The apartment is warm, clean and comfortable, with air conditioning and a small kitchen area. Overall it was pretty quiet and peaceful. One possible downside could be the very small shower, but the other advantages of the apartment outweigh it. I would like to separately note the most comfortable interaction with the owners of the apartment. They are always in touch, quickly respond to messages and help with all questions. Elif and Soner — you are the best! Thank you for the hospitality!

description: You can have a great time as a family in this stylish and useful apartment close to everything in the center of Istanbul and you can easily access everywhere.

reviews.text: The property was exactly as described. It was very clean and comfortable.

We came with a big family for an engagement party. Nilufer made us feel right at home and provided clear instructions of how to check in. The apartment is clean, spacious and comfortable. Definitely recommending the place!

Nilüfer is one of the best hosts I've interacted with.
Great price, just as advertised, perfect location everything relatively close from shops, pharmacies to restaurants.
I recommend Nilüfer & her properties for anyone coming to instanbul.
what a beautiful city.

Girene kadar her şey iyiydi Nilüfer hanım her şeye net ve hızlı cevaplar verdi. Eve girdiğimizde bir odanın lambası yanmıyordu hemen birini gönderip halletti.
