Fakat yataklar da kıl ve kan lekeleri vardı geç giriş yaptığımız ve ücreti ödediğimiz için yedek çarşaflardan olduğu kadar idare etmeye çalıştık bu durum için de o anda yapılacak bir şey olmadığından söyleme gereği duymadık ve çıkartıp banyoya koyduk çıkarken de bunu bildirdik ve bir özür veya kusura bakmayın bile demeyi çok gördü ev sahibi kendisi “👍🏼” bu emojiyi bırakarak bizi memnuniyetsiz bir şekilde yolculamış oldu. Evin çevresine gelecek olursak kız kıza tatile çıkıyorsanız çok size göre olmayabilir 100m yakınında ki markete gittiğimiz halde alkollü kişiler tarafından sözlü tacize uğradık. Bir daha bu semt ve bu evi tercih etmem.

perfect location with private parking
easy to check in
thanks 😊
sure will visit aging

description:
Authentic Ottoman-style 2BR Apartment in Historical Istanbul.
Located on the main street of Kumkapı, Fatih — close to Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, and the Grand Bazaar.
Our 55m² cozy and stylish home features 2 bedrooms, a full kitchen, and a bathroom.
Perfect for families, couples, and travelers. We’re a family-run business with 30+ years of hospitality, offering warm, 24/7 support and a shared terrace with sea views.
Please note: the building does not have an elevator.

reviews.text: Barbaros and his team made us feel like family. From the moment we contacted them to the time we, reluctantly, left we were looked after so well. Nothing was a problem and they will care for you as honoured guests. The apartment is exactly like the pictures (and even has a sea view). Anything we needed they immediately found for us, including help with posting things home and shopping for leather clothing. The apartment is in the old city in a perfect location to walk to all the main attractions (plus shopping). It is also right in the centre of restaurants. you could not find anything better in Istanbul. The location is perfect for tourists, dining, shopping and exploring. Everyone was friendly, helpful and kind. Our apartment was on the 4th floor so if stairs are a problem ask him for something closer to the ground, though the building is typical of older Turkish family homes that have been carefully renovated, plus they carried our luggage for us up and down again! The apartment was very clean and beautifully appointed and has the best shower I have seen in a hotel/home. The rooms also have a washing machine which is great for weary travellers who have been on the road awhile. We booked for a week and loved it so much we stayed longer. The rooms have large TVs and also good wifi, so it was our Turkish home away from home, Thank you Barbaros!

We had an overall nice stay at the apartment. Communication with Barbaros was good. He found us even though my phone was dead and he helped us for the taxi from the airport. The room was clean and well equipped with all the essentials. No problem with internet, water or electricity. The location is convenient. There are gazillions of restaurants, shops, baklava stores, etc. around. Is it close to the main attractions of Istanbul. However, kumkapi is a very busy district with toooons of people and cars so it will be noisy in the room facing the street, but that’s the price you gotta pay for staying in the city center :) we got used to the noise after one night :p
The place was not perfect, there were some minor issues such as a window not sealing properly, but nothing too bothersome for us. We had a nice week at Barbaros place.

We really enjoyed our stay at Barbaros! The apartment is beautiful, exactly like the photos, and clean. For us - family of 4 - it was perfect because we had seperate bedrooms. Nice firm beds btw.
Location-wise it was good; we could walk to the main historical attractions such as the Blue Mosque and big bazar (a bit hilly though, you have to take that into account if you're not a fan of walking). Istanbul offers perfect metro/tram transport. The hammam Barbaros recommended was perfect (5 min walk from the apt).
Barbaros and his guys are great hosts; carried our suitcases all the way up, arranged shuttle service to the airport, explained everything about the surroundings, thanks for that! What I really liked was that Barbaros is 24/7 available for all questions etc.

Barbaros was an amazing host. He was very diligent about keeping in touch (we were having trouble with our cell phone and his efforts were appreciated). When we arrived, he provided us with tea and gave us an overview of the area along with a map and things we should know about eating, traveling, and purchasing goods in the area. We were there on New Years eve and it was snowing. There was no way we could get a taxi (everyone wanted one that night). Barbaros arranged a driver for our activities that night – a real life saver. I cannot say enough good thing about our host. He was definitely looking out for us.

This lodging is in a great part of the older section of Istanbul (outside the major tourist areas) but within walking distance of the Grand Bazaar, Blue Mosque, Aya Sofya… Good food, stores, bakeries, Turkish bath are all nearby. The lodging was comfortable, clean, and secure. Barbaros had someone downstairs that could help us within minutes.

Barbaros's management of the building (multiple units, including this one) is very professional, and we had a great stay. The unit is conveniently located near the major attractions of the old city (Grand Bazaar and Blue Mosque), and they recently completed a remodel, including a totally new bathroom.
Hosts were very helpful at check-in, arranging pick-up from the airport and carrying some of our luggage up the stairs, and had good recommendations in the neighborhood.
Our only critique is that we ran out of hot water on the last day of our stay (we got a bit of a later start); otherwise, we recommend it completely.

reviews.text:
First the positives
. Location was good. Very close to Taksim Square.
. The unit was spacious.
Now the negatives.
. No communication from the host until I reached out on the morning of the check in. I had to contact at around 11 to get the check in instruction. But the host was quick to respond to our messages.
. The direction on the listing on google map was wrong. We went down the hill to find that the direction was wrong. Apple map shows the proper place.
. There is no elevator and the stairs to the unit was very narrow circular staircase. Hard to carry suitcase.
. Unit was dirty. We found mold inside refrig. Kitchen sink had some mold. Pots and pans were all worn out and dirty. Top of portable stove was all rusty. Floor was broomed but dusts were still there. Bed sheet had very bad smell. We couldn’t stay and the host was gracious enough to let us cancel.

Şu ana kadar kaldığım evler arasında konumsal olarak en iyi olandı. Aslı hanım ve asistanıyla iletişim gayet hızlıydı. Mutfaktaki araç ve gereçlerinin biraz kirli olması ve genel olarak evin eski olması eksi tarafları diyebilirim. Sıcaklık bakımından gayet iyi, yatak rahat. Duş ve tuvalet aynı yerde ama kendileri zaten fotoğraflarda bunu gösterdikleri için olumsuz bir şey diyemem. Genel bakıldığında İstanbul’da tercih edeceğim evlerden birisi. Kendisine teşekkür ederim.

This apartment offers a great value for its price. It's located 5 minutes from Taksim Square, close to various shops, bars, restaurants, and accessible to multiple transportation systems. It's only 15 minutes away from the major tourist attractions in the city. Asli is an amazing host, very responsive and willing to ensure our stay was comfortable. I highly recommend it.

We really enjoyed our stay at Asli's place, it has a lovely living room with beautiful decor and all the necessities. The bathroom is small with open shower, but we quickly got used to it.
The location is great, 3 min walk both to Taksim and Istiklal. Of course, being that central means noise, but Asli's street is quieter than most, and bedroom window opens onto the parking. The parking can be noisy at times, including nights, but still much better than the street and mostly quiet.
Asli is an incredible host, the most attentive I ever had! She was always available, answered all questions and always checked on us, which was very sweet. We had a couple of issues the first day, and Asli was super nice and fast in sorting out everything.
I can easily recommend the place and, most importantly, Asli as a fantastic host
A perfect location close to all amenities and especially Esteklel Street (Taksim) in a secure area. well-equipped and clean studio ideally like the photos. The host is very nice, I highly recommend.

reviews.text:
I didn’t have a great experience in this airbnb, especially considering the high price my family and I paid. We spent four weeks at Mucahid and Burak's apartment. Let me start with the positives - the apartment itself is spacious, and the beds are comfortable. The neighborhood is fantastic, with Galata Tower just a short walk away, surrounded by shops and restaurants. Having a market downstairs and an elevator was really convenient, especially for accessibility.
However, over the four weeks, we encountered several frustrating maintenance and cleanliness issues (ie dirty bathrooms and floors). It took multiple complaints before they took us seriously about persistent problems like the broken toilet seat, ac etc.
While Burak and Mucahid are always responsive and very apologetic, the fact that there were so many issues in the first place was overwhelming. It would be better if they invested in fixing up the place and hired more cleaners to ensure a better guest experience.

The place was in a great location. Definitely right in the main area. Inside was a different story. The are of furnishings good quality and very comfortable and exactly like the photos. The big issue was cleanliness. The flat even though it was cleaned before us was still left dirty. We could not shower the first night there because both showers were very dirty and the kitchen sink was also very dirty. However I did message him and he had a cleaner come in the next morning and cleaned well but it should of been done before we arrived . Also we were short on sheets and pillows that we needed to use for the sofa sleeper. When we asked the first night he said he would bring them but he only brought one set and and told us he would bring the second one the next morning which he never did so we just used what we had. Also the kitchen wares were kind of disorganized and not really full sets of anything. So we just bought or own paper cups and plates. He is very responsive though.

We had a mixed experience with this Airbnb which lead me to give it a 3 star rating. Overall, I personally wouldn’t stay here again as AC in the summer is very important for me as is a strong WI-FI connection which this place didn’t have. Either. Also we had an issue where they arranged airport transfer for us which never showed up. Luckily we were able to find an Uber at 5am to take us or we would have missed our flight.
Pros- excellent location, elevator, enough room for a family, relatively clean. Responsive and friendly host, nice cafes, grocery, and restaurants all within a short walk.
Cons- listing says AC, however there is only a small wall unit in the living room. The 3 bedrooms did not have AC and we were visiting on a very hot summer week which made it very uncomfortable.
Very basic accommodations- not fully stocked as some Airbnbs are.
For us, WI-FI was very weak even on the more powerful network so it was difficult to work from here or take meetings.

The location is great! A few minutes walk to Galata Tower, İstiklal Avenue. It is not far from metro station Şişhane and the tram line that goes directly to The Blue Mosque, Ayasofya. There are numerous restaurants, cafes, shops around the appartments.
One more advantage that the building has elevator.
The size of the appartments is big enough to feel 6-7 persons comfortable.
The host Mücahid is very friendly, hospitable, was always ready to help us.
What was not enough is the cleanliness: we have small children that spend much time on the floor, so we had to clean the floor by ourselves as it was dusty and in spots in some places.

Fantastic place that I’d love to come back for another stay. Great location and beautiful private road. Host is friendly and fixed one issue we had with hot water in a timely manner.
I’m leaving some feedback however to make the place even better:
1. As it’s common in Turkey, other guests have smoked indoors and there is strong smell of smoke when you walk inside.
2. Some necessities are missing, like no dishwasher or washing powder and no salt.
3. There was a shortage of cutlery for a family of 7 when we stayed. There is room to add more dishes and cookware.
Overall 5/5.

reviews.text: Good location and lovely place to stay. Few things didn’t make it a 5-star. One, the small room in the flat has no ventilation and got really hot at night. Two, the host forgot to share the 2nd door code with us for the flat. We were sitting in the stairs, all confused & had to contact AirBnb support and after 20-30mins the host contacted & we got it. Everything else was really great- clean place, comfortable (big room with balcony). Would recommend staying here.

My adult daughter and I shared the apartment and found it comfortable and accurately equipped as described. It’s worth noting that if four guests are staying, there are only two chairs at the indoor table and two benches available on the balcony. The seating was quite adequate for two.
Dogukan communicated clearly, and the instructions for accessing the apartment were easy to follow.
The location is very convenient—just a short walk to Istiklal Street and within walking distance of Taksim Square. My daughter arrived ahead of me by taxi and was initially a bit unsure about the appearance of the street, which is a little run-down. However, I had read previous guest reviews and knew the apartment is not located in the more upscale part of the neighborhood, across Istiklal. So it matched my expectations. In fact, seeing children playing outside in the evening gave me a sense that the area felt safe.
Overall, I enjoyed my stay and wouldn’t hesitate to book this apartment again.

We had a really nice stay at the apartment. It was exactly like the pictures, very clean and comfortable, and the check-in instructions were super clear, which made everything easy. The host was also very kind and flexible when we asked to check out later, which we really appreciated. Inside the apartment everything was good, though we couldn’t find a broom to clean the floor (maybe we just didn’t see it, but it didn’t seem to be there).
The only downside was that there were major roadworks right outside, so getting in and out was a bit difficult, and the area itself didn’t always feel like the safest. But overall, it was a good experience and we’re grateful for the hospitality!

We are very happy with our stay at Doğukan's property. Everything was exactly as described and shown in the photos. Doğukan is a great host, the moving instructions he gave us at the beginning were extremely detailed and accurate and it was more than easy for us to move in. The apartment is clean, has everything necessary for the comfort of its guests. I highly recommend it and we will definitely come back there again, on some of our next visits to Istanbul. Thanks Doğukan!

The apartment is spacious and in a quiet area. The host was vvery responsive. I slept in the smaller bedroom and the mattresses and pillows were very comfortable.Simple but nice decor. Some people have mentioned they didnt feel safe in this area but I didnt have any issues walking to and from the apartment , day or night.The security is very good in the building. The local shopkeepers in this area were friendly. There is also a police station 5 min from the apartment. .

description: First of all, I would like to say that if anyone wants to come and get the key first and then enter the apartment with three or four people, they should definitely not make a reservation. No one other than two people can enter the apartment, and you must be of legal age. NOTE: We do not allow one-night guests to cook.

reviews.text:
Burak was great and very responsive. Also, Rasul was very helpful and friendly as well. Quick in response and tried to help as much as possible. My stay was a bit unfortunate. Some neighbours issue took place, get’s pretty noisy late night and all other sort of stuff. It had a huge impact on my sleep and couldn’t sleep. I am a light sleeper, things may differ people to people.
Regarding cleanliness, it was not good at all. I personally had to clean the apartment from floor to toilet and everything. If the Apartment was cleaned it would have been much much better.
Location is excellent, there is no word to that, easily accessible everywhere.
I guess it’s a bit too pricy for what I got. 2/3 of that price is considerable.

I had an amazing experience in the heart of Bakirkoy town. I must say, the lovely flat and Burak exceeded all my expectations. There's no need to hesitate - just book it. The flat was perfect in size, with plenty of special touches, and was impeccably clean. It had all the basic kitchen and bathroom needs covered. The location is superb, right in the heart of Bakirkoy town, minutes away from the metro and other public transportation options. There are numerous shops, restaurants, and coffee shops nearby, and the area exudes traditional Turkish vibes while also being safe and quiet. Burak was a true gentleman, being highly responsive to my messages and very helpful upon my arrival. I now know exactly where I'll be staying on my next visit to Istanbul.
Highly recommended!!

We had a great stay at this apartment in the heart of Bakırköy. The place was clean, well-kept, and exactly as described. The location was perfect—close to everything we needed. A special thanks to Burak, who was incredibly kind and helpful, even going out of their way to help us recover some lost items after we had already checked out. Highly recommended!

Konaklamamız gerçekten harikaydı. Ev tertemiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha güzeldi. Konumu çok merkezi ve ulaşım açısından oldukça rahattı. Ev sahibi son derece ilgili, nazik ve hızlı geri dönüş yaptı; her konuda yardımcı oldu. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik. Gönül rahatlığıyla herkese tavsiye ederim, tekrar gelmeyi çok isteriz.

Burak Bey ilgili dost canlısı bir ev sahibiydi, iletişim kurmak kolaydı, sorularımıza hızlı dönüşler sağladı. Daire fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Daireye giriş konusunda zorlanmadık kolay bir şekilde giriş yaptık. Daire temiz ve genişti ve eksiksizdi, uzun süre kalmaya da elverişliydi. Fiyat-performans olarakta gayet iyi bir daireydi. Gönül rahatlığıyla kiralayabilirsiniz.

description: Hello everyone. Our apartmen in Kadıköy. One minute walk from the port. Please feel free to ask all your questions and requests. I will be happy to answer.

reviews.text:
Convenient, comfortable and clean room with an easy check-in.
The kitchen even had boiler and coffee-tea to start nicely the day.
Come with your earplug since the neighborhood is quite noisy, but that's the price to enjoy the beat of the neighborhood :)

I had a great stay at Serhat‘s place in Kadiköy and want to come back and stay again for longer. I arrived very late from the airport so I was relieved that the place was super close to the Atatürk airport shuttle stop and walkable despite my big bags. It was a very smooth check in even late at night and I was pleased to find the balcony room on the top level. The area is cute and very close to the pier and metro station and lots of eateries. I especially loved the very large balcony with a partial view of of the water and down the narrow streets of the neighborhood.
The rooms were clean and comfortable and the bed very comfortable and large too. Many Towels and even slippers were provided.
Serhat was friendly and quick communicating and very helpful with the time situations and questions I had. Can’t wait to come back for a long stay!!

Very clean and comfortable apartment! Looks exactly like the photos. Easy to find and the heart of Kadikoy is all within walking distance. We had breakfast on the balcony and watched the seagulls and magpipes. It's a good size for two people. Note for people with a lot of luggage: the elevator goes up to the floor below and then you walk up one flight of stairs to the apartment.

We had a very nice stay at Serhat’s place. Everything was exactly as expected, and the apartment was clean and comfortable. The location was excellent and made our trip very convenient. Thank you for hosting us.

Öncelikle giriş gayet sorunsuz ve kolaydı. Oda tam olarak açıklamasını ve fotoğrafları doğru bir şekilde yansıtıyordu. Gayet temizdi hiçbir rahatsızlık duymadık. Konumunun çok iyi olması burayı tercih etmemizdeki en etkili faktörlerden biri oldu diyebilirim. Ayrıca bütün bu iyi deneyimimize ek olarak Serhat Bey sorularımızı hep hızlı yanıtladı ve iletişimi de oldukça iyiydi. Bütün bunlar çerçevesinde gönül rahatlığı ile tercih edebileceğiniz bir yer olarak burayı kesşnlikle tavsiye ederim.

description: Our apartments are distinguished by the spacious area suitable for family residence, as it contains all the necessary necessities for a comfortable and happy stay, where you feel as if you are in your own home. We also have a 24/24 reception desk to secure the needs of guests at any time, and the entire building contains a security system and cameras that work around the clock In addition to the availability of the Internet throughout the hotel, also the apartments have amazing city view

reviews.text: Honestly, we felt deceived by the great comments about cleanliness and the staff kindness of this place. The couch in the living room had two big stains, and an old olive in one of the bowls. The sheets also had some unremoved stains for which case it shouldn't have been reused for new guests. Most importantly, one of the staff had a completely unacceptable questioning attitude towards us. But the gentle manager called us to apologize and offered refund or a free stay, and said that the relevant staff will no longer work there. It was a relieving gesture for solid communication. We didn't accept the offers because we enjoyed our stay and the location of the hotel. The manager also made it up for us with his mediating response.

I recently stayed at this property with my family for a vacation. As a frequent Airbnb user, I generally book entire homes to enjoy a relaxed and private stay. Sadly, this experience did not meet the expectations I’ve come to expect from Airbnb.
The kitchen amenities were quite limited, more like a hotel room than a full kitchen, which made it challenging for us to prepare meals. Additionally, there was a persistent leak in the bathroom that wasn’t addressed during our stay.
One of the most disappointing aspects was an unpleasant argument we had with the receptionist, which could have been resolved with clearer communication and a respectful approach. However, the host’s response was surprisingly rude, leaving us feeling unwelcome. On a few other occasions, we noticed similar tensions between the receptionist and other guests, which made the overall environment feel unsafe and uncomfortable.
While I share this as constructive feedback in the hope it might help the host enhance their

It was a nice stay at Hexa Apartments.
Everything went fine, the staff were very friendly and supportive.
The apartment was big and comfortable and very suitable for family stays regardless the sanitary ware in the bathroom and kitchen that needs repair or change as they are not practical enough.
Everything else was very good.
The surrounding is nice, few minutes walking to main shopping streets and restaurants in the heart of Sisli.
20 - 25 minutes walking to Cehavir Mall and 35 minutes walking to Taksim. Which is not considered so far in a city like Istanbul as by car it make sometimes take almost the same time due to high traffic.

description: A wonderful and elegant apartment in a quiet place with a beautiful view and suitable for the family. We also have more than 6 apartments on the same floor that can be used if there is more than one family

reviews.text: the apartment was exactly like the photos. Khaled was always responsive and helpful. clean place with peaceful surroundings which i was after. I highly recommend this place for people that wants a quiet and relaxing place

What a great stay!
Location, View, Furniture, Cleanness, Amenities, everything was just wonderful.
Khalid was a great host, highly responsive and supportive, made everything possible and did his best to make our stay even more exciting.
I strongly recommend this apartment, and definitely coming back.
It is my new home in Istanbul.
Ev çok güzel temiz sakin hüzur doluydu,aynı istediyim gibi. Ben çok sevdim. Ev sahibi de çok iyi her konuda yardım ede bilecek her saatde sorularınızı cavablayacak. Çok teşekkürler .
Khaled is a very responsive host, and his apartment is simply beautiful, we were very comfortable. The staff inside the building is also very responsive, I recommend visiting!

We stayed here for the second time, and it was just as amazing as before! The place is beautiful, clean, and very comfortable. Everything was perfect, and we truly enjoyed our stay again. Highly recommend! We would definitely come back.

description:
Hi friends
The house is located in the historical central peninsula of Istanbul, in Beyoğlu, a few steps away from the Galata Tower. There are well-known restaurants and cafes, art galleries and boutique shops and markets within a few minutes' distance. All tourist attractions are within walking distance. You'll have more than the needs of travelers.

reviews.text:
The apartment is in a good location, walkable to a lot of attractions. The host was very responsive and when we had issues with the bathroom light (wouldn‘t turn on and off) he tried to fix it and checked on us multiple times.
The apartment itself is - as described in the listing - in an older building, which you can definitely tell. Kitchen cupboards are falling apart, parts of the ceiling were on the ground and the bathroom pipes smell really bad. Overall it is worth the price for a short stay.

Fatih's place is spacious, comfortable and bright, with high ceilings. The bedrooms face the back of the building and the windows are double-glazed, making it a quiet space for sleeping and relaxing. We could hear the neighbours upstairs sometimes, but it did not cause any significant disturbance. The location is great, within easy reach (on foot) of the Galata bridge. At Galataport you'll find plenty of restaurants for evening meals, but the kitchen is also well equipped if you want to prepare some meals at home.
Fatih is a wonderful host, extremely responsive, very attentive and friendly. He really cares about his guests and wants to make sure that you are comfortable and happy. He is very open to suggestions and when we mentioned a small problem with the cleanliness in the bedrooms, he went out of his way to make things right for us and ensure it won't happen again for future guests. We would be happy to return and can recommend his place to others.

We had a wonderful stay at Fatih’s Airbnb in Beyoğlu. The location is excellent, very convenient, close to public transport, shops, and attractions, yet still comfortable for resting after a long day. The place was clean, well-maintained, and exactly as described. Fatih was a very responsive and helpful host, making our stay smooth and pleasant. We truly enjoyed our time here and would highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul.

Overall we were happy with the apartment. The location was great with lots of local cafes and restaurants nearby and only 10 minutes from the central area and the water front. There was plenty of space and the lounge area had comfortable seating for 4/5 people.
Fatih was very helpful and proactive with communication and arranged an airport pick up for us on request.
The apartment is in a heritage building and has lots of character but also has lots of power points plus new double glazed windows which provided effective sound proofing.
The downside was that some fixtures and fittings were not in great condition. Kitchen equipment was incomplete and freezer frosted up. A couple of light bulbs were blown and some of the bathroom accessories were old or not well cleaned. These issues could be quickly rectified at which point the apartment would definitely be recommended.

The place is a charming old-city apartment with plenty of character. It was exactly as described on the photos, clean and welcoming. It was also warm, which is a useful attribute for late-November in Istanbul! The location is next to Galata Port and the Galata Tower, which are very touristy, but the street is super quiet at night so you'll get a good night's sleep. The host is super nice and responsive. Loved our stay and would not hesitate to stay again!

description: Our building has 5 floors and all areas have been restored and renovated with quality materials, blending the comfort of our guests with my 10 years of tourism accommodation experience, considering the finest details. My apartment is decorated to accommodate four people comfortably. My apartment has 1 bedroom, 1 living room, 1 bathroom and 1 balcony. ID is required at the entrance. There is no elevator. Our apartment has high-speed fiber internet at 820 Mbps.

reviews.text:
There were some pickups during the checkin which were all resolved by the first day so I decided to still give a good review for my 6-day stay.
location: glamorous would describe the opposite but that's exactly why I also enjoyed it, blending in with the local community and being away from the picture-perfect tourist hotspots. At night it appears a bit raw but actually I felt never threatened or anything like that. Sundays is a very big market 20m away from the house which also added to a cool experience. There are also plenty of small shops around.
unit: it's very spacious and relatively newly renovated. I was on the top floor, so it was flooded with light. the bathroom is small but modern and everything was clean and tidy upon my checkin. Kitchen utensils are rather limited (please add some more glasses/cups).
Overall and specifically because of the reasonable price, I would recommend staying there.

The apartment was very dirty upon check-in. There were stains on the bed, unfresh bedding, a huge amount of other people’s hair in the bed, and a dirty toilet, cups, and floor. The host only addressed this issue the next day, but even then, the problem was only partially resolved. Additionally, the number of towels provided did not match the number of guests.
The neighborhood where the apartment is located is genuinely unsafe compared to most other areas in Istanbul.
Upon check-out, the host unexpectedly mentioned unwashed dishes and garbage not being taken out, which I don’t understand, as cleaning was included in the rental price.

The apartment was exactly as the pictures, it was clean and everything was working just fine.
The communication was fluid even on the first day saygi gave me instructions for worthy visit places.
I had a very good time its a few minutes walk away to istiklal cad.
I HIGHLY recommend!
Thank you Saygi for the wonderful stay!

Great apartment! We have been living here for 1 month.
Firstly, everything is new, after renovation. Decoration is cozy and comfortable. Separate bedroom. Good bathroom, cold and hot water. There are washing machine, vacuum cleaner and iron. There are also heaters and air conditioner. Good wifi, suitable for remote work.
Second, convenient location. There are 2 grocery shops and bakery. Istiklal street in 10 minutes.
Bazar on nearby street every Sunday.
Pharmacy, bus stops.
The owner is very hospitable. He helped us in every issue and was very polite, thank you, Abdullah!

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment.
The apartment is beautiful, very clean, comfortable, and cozy. Everything was well-organized and exactly as described.
The host was very responsive and always answered our requests quickly, which made our stay even more pleasant.
We truly felt comfortable here and would gladly stay again. Highly recommended!

description: Our apartment is on the seafront and on the street. It is in the city center and near the Galata Tower. We are in a great location. We are next to the Haliç metro station. Galata Tower is within walking distance. Taksim is 1 stop away. You can get to places such as Eminönü, Hagia Sophia and the Grand Bazaar by tram. The tram stop is within walking distance. Perfect location. There's a view from the terrace floor. You won't find this view anywhere else. All of Istanbul will be in front of your eyes. I'll be the best host.

reviews.text: The place is great, we struggled finding it for a bit because we did not know the area and our maps apps were a bit broken but we messaged the owner and he gave us instructions of how to find it exactly and we got there, the owner was very responsive and helpful with any issues, the area is very safe and secure with a beautiful view from the roof of the building in an outdoor lounge area, for the same view of the entire city many other hotels would charge over 10x the amount so this place is worth it’s value, the location is perfect placed within a 5 minute walk of the ferry that takes you to other parts of Istanbul and many restaurants, market etc within walking distance, the room was lovely, comfortable bed, clean bathroom and bed sheets, and a tv with access to many streaming services, everything was perfect and I plan on staying here again next time I visit Istanbul.

Ali is a great host, he was helpful and nice. The room is excellent, the furniture is new. There was a kitchen downstairs but we didn’t use it cause all of the restaurants and cafes were 10/20-minute walk from the apartment. The only thing that bothered us a little was the weird smell in the room and that it was quite cold in the bathroom. Everything else was great! Especially the location, you can get anywhere you want easily.

Don't expect an apartment - its just small room. The bathroom lacks any ventilation and smelled bad. The kitchen is very tiny and below a very risky flight of stairs - shouldn't be counted upon at all for cooking. The lift often breaks down and can pose a challenge when carrying luggage.
Location though is super!!! A 2 mins walk to the water front where you can watch the world go by with the glittering skyline of the golden horn just beyond. Halic metro, galata tower and karakoy tram station are all just a short walk away. This means all the places of interest all very easily accessed. Excellent view from the terrace - not to be missed if renting this place.
Deniz was super helpful and very polite.

Our stay in Istanbul was perfect! The terrace upstairs offered an amazing view of the city, and watching the sunset from there was truly special. The host was very accommodating and even allowed us to check out later since our flight was a bit later. He was always quick to respond to any questions or issues, which made our stay even better.
The room was clean, comfortable, and had all the amenities we needed. The bathroom was modern and well - maintained. Most attractions were within walking distance, making it super convenient. Plus, having Netflix to relax with after a long day out was a great bonus. Highly recommend this place!

Ali is a very responsive host and very accommodating. We had some issues with the iron, but he immediately sort it out.
Ali provided us with extra blanket upon request. Truly appreciate this. The kitchen is small but functional. Everything is clean and spotless. I can even see the Bosphorus from the kitchen.
The apartment is a walking distance to two metro stations. It’s easy to get to the apartment from the airport too! Bonus point right there! It’s not located on a hill, so it’s convenient if you have heavy luggage.
You can watch the sunrise from the rooftop while sipping coffee in the morning. It’s beautiful. Plenty of restaurants and cafe nearby too. Everything is walking distance

description:
M3 Flat is a wide and spacious flat with elevator and it's right next to Taksim / Istiklal which is the heart of Istanbul where all the shopping centers and the entertainment places are at. You will have access to all metro stations from Taksim Square and also IETT busses that go all around the city via the street.
The flat is furnished with all the necessary amenities such as a mini fridge, a microwave, washing machine and a dryer machine etc.

reviews.text:
A great apartment in need of some maintenance. I had a great time at Sedat’s place - the location is very well connected and the apartment itself is comfortable. The only real problem was the bathroom, which is in need of some maintenance / redecorating. The photos must be quite old, as they do not reflect the current state of the bathroom, which has quite a lot of mold, especially in the shower. The shower door does not close, which makes it difficult to prevent water from overflowing into the rest of the bathroom. There was also occasionally an unpleasant smell coming from the sink in the bathroom.
Other than that this is a great place, and Sedat was a friendly and helpful host who provided very clear and useful check in instructions. If the bathroom were to be deep cleaned / updated this would be a 5 star place.

Sedat's was clean and beautiful as shown with pictures. It's walkable, easy to access to everything. you only need to take few steps to access elevator. The Kitchen had items you would need overall. Sedat is very responsive. He also let me stay for few more hours as I had a late flight, that was a big help! The only thing was about bathroom door that wouldn't close thus let the water splash get to the toilet side that has another sink to collect the water. I would recommend this place if you are looking for a highly convenient location in Beyoglu/Taksim.

Great stay overall! The location is excellent—just a short walk to Istiklal Street, perfect for exploring Istanbul's vibrant nightlife. There are plenty of restaurants and a cozy cafeteria right downstairs, which was super convenient. Bus stations are also easily reachable, making it simple to get around the city. The apartment has a lift, but it starts from the first floor, so you’ll need to carry your bags up one flight of stairs—that’s the only minor drawback. Otherwise, everything was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Would happily stay here again!

Guys, I definitely recommend this spacious apartment! First of all, Sedat is a wonderful person. He will always prompt/help everything, he is always in touch and also helped us with the suitcase (for which special thanks). A kind and neat person. Secondly, the apartment is super. Unsurpassed location (only 10 steps to Istiklal Street). Importantly, there is an elevator here! Beautiful design, comfortable bed with a pillow, CLEAN, quiet enough (despite the club and party place). It's very nice to be in his apartment. Everything corresponds to the photos and description. I would live here all the time :)
Therefore, without a doubt, choose this apartment, as it is really comfortable and pleasant. I hope I'll come to you again :)

The place was wonderful just 100 steps to istiklal street. Place is exactly same as shown in the pictures. If you are travelling with pram there will be little difficulty as from ground floor you need to carry baby pram to climb stairs then you will have lift access. Other than this place was comforting and because its in the heart of city you will have access to every amenity. Sedat was very responsive and a very good host. He described checkin and internet access very well which made it easy for us to have a comforting stay. Definitely and a must recommended place if no baby with pram on board.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family. You'll have the best location. And you'll spend your time just enjoying yourself. Located just 100 meters from the Galata Tower, this place is within a pleasant walking distance to many central areas such as Taksim, Galataport and Karaköy.

reviews.text:
Fatih was an incredibly responsive and sweet host! He owns the cafe across the street and was responded super quick to any of my messages!
The location is right in the heart of Galata next to Galata Tower so it’s quite busy. The apartment was tidy and as pictured although some of the furnishings seem to be a bit dated. It is on the third floor but there is an elevator in the building! The elevator was down for repairs my last day so we had to take the stairs which are frankly a little bit creepy. Dim to no light and not clean.
We were a group of four staying. Note that one of the beds is located in the living room right next to the bathroom.
All that said Fatihs kindness, the location, and the value of the place are well worth it for a few days!

The place was exactly as per the pictures. We love the Beyoglu area so staying here at this price was absolute value for money. The views from the room were great especially Galata Tower! We loved being close to a mosque, it reminded us of home. There are many eating spots around the flat offering really good food at fair prices. The elevator of the apartment was a win for my husband with an ankle injury, as well as moving our luggage as a family. We made a hot breakfast at the apartment and then moved out for the day. Umbrellas provided came in handy for the rain. Internet service was faster than home - smart TV kids and gamer son were overjoyed. Very secure door to the apartment but we never ever felt concerned about safety, this is Turkiye! The cleanliness of the apartment was reasonable. Nothing weird to report on.
The host Fatih was great, offering us a kind discount at Cafe Mouette when eating there.
Save your Liras for the travel experience and make this your base!

Large, clean, & comfortable apartment in an amazing location. Everything is as described in the listing. Host was friendly and easy to communicate with. Expect some street noise given the popularity of the Galata tower area and adjacent mosque. It's an older building lacking curb appeal, but the apartment is more modern and the lift is helpful. I was only missing a dining room table and there is opportunity for some cosmetic touch ups. I would recommend this apartment and return.

We had a very comfortable stay, it’s a nice apartment for a family of 6. Fatih provided a cot for our baby and the sofa beds were good for the older kids. The apartment was clean and exactly like the pictures. Fatih is very friendly and helpful. Its great to have a lift since the apartment is on the 3rd floor. Great location, lots of nice cafes nearby. I’d recommend anyone to stay here.

Fatih is great host and made us feel at home. He was very responsive and helpful (he even took care of lifting my family's luggages up the elevator, he recommended some places to eat, gave us some good tips about the city, etc). And his place was true to the pictures and the description. Good value for money, at a great location in Istanbul.

description: Boutique Tiny House with a Jacuzzi, riverfront pier and private garden in lush nature, 3 km (5 min) from the center of Agva and the beach. The price includes breakfast for 2 people.

reviews.text: Konaklama yerimiz, banyo, mutfak, yatak odası temizdi, kullanım için gerekli olan mutfak ve yatak odasındaki eşyalar ihtiyacımız kadarı ile vardı ve kullanışlıydı, sağanak yağmur olmasına rağmen bahçede barbekü yapabildik, mobilyaları özenle seçilmişti, isteğimiz olduğunda hızlıca çözüm yolu buldular, teşekkür ediyoruz
Ev sahibi gayet ilgiliydi evin yeri resimlerden daha güzeldi tekrar gideceğimiz yer olursa tekrar seçebileceğimiz bir konum ve mekan sessiz sakin kafa dinlemelik bir yer teşekkür ederiz
Konaklama yeri fotoğraflardakilerden daha güzel ve temizliği aşırı güzeldi.

kapısının önünde nehir akan bahçeli bir eviniz olduğunu düşünün.. her şeyiyle temiz ve mükemmeldi.. Netflix,internet,kahvaltı,sıcak su,buzdolabı,jakuzi, çevre düzenlemesi sorunsuz ve harikaydı. kesinlikle konaklanılmasını önerebileceğim yerlerden biri.
Her şey çok ince düşünülmüş, temizdi biz memnun kaldık. Mangal için köz vs veriyorlar tabak, bardak da mevcut. Tekrar ziyaret edebileceğimiz bir yer oldu. Ercan beye teşekkür ederiz.

description:
One of the best places in the city is Besiktas. very close to everywhere by public transport. Only 10 minutes to taksim, nisantasi for shopping, dolmabahce palace and malls. You can reach the other side of Istanbul in 5 minutes by ferry. all public transport available in front of the house.

Our apartment is very comfortable, and all furniture is new. We have an elevator. The flat is on the 4th floor and excellent Bosphorus view.

reviews.text:
Sinan’s house was fantastic! It was very clean and stylish, with everything I needed to feel at home. The bed was super comfortable and amazing view. The location was also great, right near public transportation and great places to eat and shops.
Sinan was really helpful and nice and responded quickly. he was checking in on me to make sure I had everything I needed. I Would definitely stay here again. :)

Evin konumu çok güzel ve gerçekten çok temiz. İhtiyaç duyabileceğiniz her şey en ince ayrıntısına kadar özenle düşünülmüş. Sinan Bey kaldığım süre boyunca benimle sürekli iletişim halindeydi ve her sorumu en kısa sürede yanıtladı. Ev işlek bir caddeye bakıyor ama ben gürültüden rahatsız olmadım. Herkese gönülden tavsiye ediyorum.

Well, what can I say Sinan was one of the nicest people I have ever met not only was he super helpful. He seemed like he could never do enough for you, always on Hand. His place was like a five star hotel absolutely immaculate, brand-new furniture, brand-new bed, spotless. The location you couldn’t beat it right in the town centre. the boats to the Asian side only three minutes walk in fact everything was local within walking distance . Lots of bars, Cafes and restaurants, great nightlife, too. Thank you again Sinan for being the best host ever. Hope to see you again again soon. ￼Chelsea Singh

Visitors should know that the apartment is on the fourth floor overlooking a busy road near the Besiktas ferry port, so it can be noisy in the early part of the night and through much of the day obviously. There is an elevator however and the apartment is excellently situated and equipped. Sinan was a great host and communication was excellent. Delighted to recommend.

It was great stay for me and family. It was super clean. Amazing location with good view and surroundings. Only thing i would like to let people know, its little noisy because of busy location and car traffic as well.Sinan was so responsive and helpful. Thanks to Sinan for his great hospitality.

description: Our hotel room is located in Arnavutkoy. We have comfortable rooms just 15 minutes to Airport

reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel during our one night stop over in Istanbul. 15 minutes from the airport. It cost TKL400 for the taxi. Excellent stay at this hotel. Polite, friendly and very helpful staff members. Room was clean and in very good condition. Tea, coffee, water bottles,Towels, bed slippers, shampoo, lotion, soap, toothbrushes, toothpaste, etc. available. We felt really comfortable during our stay. Only downside was the shower area water was very slow to pass while using the shower cabin. This was mentioned to the receptionist. Surrounding the hotel, there are shops, food places, mosque, etc.

We stayed for one night before our flight and were very satisfied. The room was clean, the beds comfortable, and it was quiet at night. The neighborhood itself is not extraordinary but relatively close to the airport so it was perfect for our needs.
Clean and comfortable. Will be back again in the near future

We checked in late and thats why the host allowed to check out late. Very helpful host.
Location is just too good. Amazing place and clean

Check in was smooth considering we checked in at 11pm. Room’s were a decent size and clean for our family of 4. This is a good place to stay if you need to be close to the airport. All staff members are very helpful and friendly. Thank you Doğan for a stress free stay!

description: Keep it simple at this peaceful and centrally-located place.

reviews.text: We are so glad that we stayed here for our first visit to Istanbul. When we arrived, Ali was very welcoming and ensured that we were comfortable. The apartment was clean and in a superb location, with many trendy bars, restaurants, and shops nearby in Karaköy. It is also in walking distance to the Galata Tower. The bed was comfortable and the shower was powerful - perfect for relaxing after enjoying a long day in the city!
great location.weak internet
The stairwell needs a light, otherwise the accommodation was as advertised, air con worked good, shower also worked fine. Great location.
It is actually a room, enought to rest, the location is really central and Ali was so helpful.

İlk airbnb deneyimimi bu kadar güzel yaşadığım için ev sahibine çok teşekkür ederim o kadar güvenilir ve ilgiliydi ki gözünüz kapalı gelebilirsiniz onun dışında evle alakalıda hiç sorun yaşamadım tekrar bi seyahatimde %100 tercih edeceğim bir ev ve ev sahibi her şey kusursuzdu tekrar görüşmemek dileğiyle 💖

description:
Our studio apartment with a balcony overlooking the Bosphorus on the top floor of the renovated historical mansion with a garden is only 30 seconds (100 meters) on foot to Kanlıca Square, where the bus stop, ferry pier, markets and restaurants are located.

Our house has a Residence Permit Certificate from the Ministry of Culture and Tourism. Therefore, all the features that ensure the comfort and safety of our guests are available and it is mandatory to present an ID at the entrance. For details, see the 'Other details to note' section.

reviews.text:
I had a truly lovely stay at Emre’s place.
Kanlıca is a quiet and gentle part of Istanbul, and staying here felt like stepping slightly away from the city’s busier rhythm. It’s a place that invites you to slow down, while still offering easy access to different parts of the Bosphorus.
The apartment is even more comfortable than it appears in the photos — clean, calm, and thoughtfully put together. There’s a certain care in the way everything is arranged. The balcony opens to a soft view of the water, and the light in the late afternoon lingers in a way that’s hard to forget.
Emre is a very attentive and considerate host. Before my arrival, he shared a detailed guide that made everything feel easy and well-prepared.
The apartment is just a short walk from the ferry, and at times you can hear the call to prayer from nearby. It became one of the sounds I associate most with Istanbul — distant, steady, and quietly comforting.
I felt very at ease staying here, and would happily return

Staying at Emre’s place felt more like being hosted by a Turkish friend than staying in a regular Airbnb. The house is full of character,historical and charming from the outside, while inside it is cozy, eclectic, and comfortable, with a beautiful mix of modern and classic touches that really capture the spirit of old Istanbul.
Even though it’s a studio, it feels spacious and very comfortable. The bed was great, and seeing the Bosporus while lying down was special. We especially loved the balcony, enjoying the view, the birds, and the smell of the wisteria flowers from the garden.
The apartment was spotless, quiet, and had everything we needed, including a fully equipped kitchen with very good-quality cookware. The neighborhood is also excellent, with many cafés, bakeries, and restaurants nearby, plus easy ferry and bus connections to explore the city.
Emre was always kind, responsive, and thoughtful. Thank you again for the cookies and famous Kanlıca yogurts such a lovely touch :)
Great flat, exactly as described. Very beautiful location, good connectivity and very responsive, helpful host. Would definitely recommend

We had a great stay. Mr. Emre was kind, responsive, and very helpful throughout the whole process. The flat was clean, well-equipped, and had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. The location was also convenient and quiet. We would definitely love to stay here again in the future. Highly recommended!

Emre was one of the kindest hosts I've ever met. He was very responsive and hospitable, and it was very thoughtful of him to prepare a snack box and include Kanlıca yogurt, which is locally famous.
The place was nice, neat, and clean, with cute interiors and a beautiful view. The location is amazing—right across from the Kanlıca Pier and the bus station. It’s also just two minutes away from the shore, so it was lovely to walk along the Bosphorus.
The building is a family apartment, which made it feel very safe and quiet. It was a really nice experience, and I highly recommend this place!

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
Uncomfortable and disappointing and not worth the money.
This apartment looks indeed very much like on the pictures...
However, when you arrive, you arrive literally in an empty space. There is no soap, toilet paper, nothing for dishwashing, cleaning, etc… All the very basic things you need to buy yourself.
This is how you are welcoming your tenants, or you do not… ☹
In the bedroom there is not wardrobe, no lights and no proper curtains, so it is bright at 05:30 AM.
The aircon seems to be working but is much too weak for the space. It barely manages to get the temperature under control. I believe on a normal summer day you will be lost in a sauna.
In the whole I was very disappointed about the very low and cheapest standard of the furniture and equipment. This place appeared more like in an unfinished state and is not worth the price at all.

Ev sahibi oldukca kibar, sorulara hizli ve yeterli cevap veren bir beydi. Binaya nasil girecegimiz ve anahtari nasil elde edecegimizle ilgili detayli bi video atti. Evde her şey fotograftaki gibiiydi. Kisa sureli konaklamalar icin ideal. Sadece salondaki koltuk çok çökmüştü ve evde devamli bir havalandırma sesi vardı. Bunlarin disinda mecidiyekoy metroya ve cevahir e gercekten cok yakindi. Bina oldukca guvenliydi ve ev girdigimizde gayet temizdi. Biz 10 gun konakladik, ufak tefek temizlik malzemesi birakilirsa ara ara kendimiz icin de temizlik yapabilmeyi isterdik (bez, vileda, çamaşır suyu gibi), bir de ahşap rafa birkac aski asilabilirse cok iyi olur, ona gercekten ihtiyac duyduk.
Nice place. Very good location near to public transportation. Lots of restaurants & local stores around. The place was clean & cozy. I stayed for 1 month without any problem.

Giriş yapacağımız gün aksilikler yaşanıp bir nebze hayal kırıklığına uğramış olsakta sonrasında yapılan hata çok daha iyi bir şekilde telafi edildi. Evi genelde uyumak için kullandık. Ama genel olarak tüm ihtiyaçlarıkarşılayacak gereçler mevcuttu. Belki TV bir tık daha iyi olup film izleme olanağı sunabilirdi. Kendimizi evimizde gibi hissettik. Muhit olarak çok güzel bir yerde. Metro çok yakın. Marketler, restoranlar mevcut. Biz genelde geç uyandıysak vakit kazanmak için Zoozy nin karşısındaki Semaver cafede kahvaltı yaptık. Çok tatlı bir abla ve dışarıdan simidini poğaçanı getirebiliyorsun. Bir daha İstanbul yolculuğum olursa ilk günü hatırlamazsam tekrardan teşekkür edebilirim. Teşekkür ediyorum Muhammed beye..

Je remercie muhammed pour sa réactivité, c’est la 3 eme fois que je loge dans ces appartements il est pro et répond à tous les besoins , l’appartement est très propre l’immeuble sécurisé et le quartier c’est mon préférer vu que j’ai vécu 3 ans a proximité tous est accessible je reviendrai et je vous conseil de réserver sans hésiter 🙏🏻

description:
I am renting a room in my stylish and comfortable apartment right next to the bull statue in the center of Kadıköy.
When you look out the living room window, all of Kadıköy is at your feet.
Enjoy a stylish experience in this centrally located place.

reviews.text: Evin konumu, temizliği, ev sahibinin iletişimi, ilgi alakası son derece iyiydi. Kesinlikle tavsiye edebileceğim bir yer.

ev sahibi beni çok güzel ağırladı ve sıcakkanlıydı. her soruma çok hızlı yanıt verdi. ev son derece temiz ve herşey göründüğü gibiydi. banyo ve yatak çok temizdi begendim. tekrar konaklamayı düşünüyorum ☺️

bizden önce kalan birileri olduğu için sanırım ortak alanların temizliğinde özellikle tuvalet ve banyoda sıkıntı vardı ama odamız temizdi. evde şofbeni filan açmamız gerektiğine dair bilgi vermedi buz gibi suyla duş almak zorunda kaldık. kendisi yoktu erkek arkadası karsıladı bizi ama o da anahtarı verip direkt gitti hiçbir bilgilendirmede bulunmadı. eve giris saati olarak 5te girebileceğimiz haberi geldi ki elimizde eşyalarımız vardı ve biraz zorlandık açıkçası. ama her şey için teşekkürler evin konumu ve odamız gayet güzeldi.
Çok memnun kaldık tavsiye ediyoruz konum olarak çok merkezi olması yanısıra evi tertemiz ve düzenliydi ev sahibi çok sıcak kanlı ve anlayışlıydı tekrar teşekkür ederiz 💖
She was a very kind and nice owner. The place was clean and comfortable. Hope we will see each other next time

description: This is a vintage studio room, it has a bathroom and kitchen, wifi, air conditioning, TV, hot water, towels are available. It is a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Street and is in a quiet and peaceful area.

reviews.text:
Pros:
- located very close to the lively area but at the same time on a tiny quiet street with no traffic, so the outer sounds are not a problem in a loud Istanbul.
- cute and tidy vintage apartment is worth its cost: bed is comfortable, wifi is stable, hot water is available, etc.
- check-in is very simple, the host is very hospitable and attentive
- we were provided with towels and slippers, there was soap for the hands and for the shower, hairdryer, heater etc., so we were not lacking anything
- bus stop is just 2 min away
Cons:
- not too much of kitchen equipment - limited number of forks, spoons, cups and glasses, no kitchen towels (for us it was not an issue because we only ate out, but for someone it might be)
- not the most picturesque street of the town (again, for us it was not a problem, we were out the whole time)

Overall great value for money with a few minor niggles.
Pros:
-Great location - quite central, close to Galata bridge & Galata tower
-Flexible easy convenient check-in. The room was ready even before check-in time
-Clean & quiet
-Very responsive host, always checking in to see if we needed anything. We have asked for a few essentials and these were provided within a day
-The host allowed us to keep luggage in the building after checking out for the day
Cons:
- Air con is not working and the small portable radiator left in the room is barely sufficient to keep the place warm if kept on for hou
-When we arrived the place lacked cutlery and other essentials for a comfortable stay. If you are planning to stay 'just for a bed', you may still want to ask for an additional blanket. Luckily the host provided, when asked
- My biggest pet peeve was the broken showerhead holder. Lovely shower, would have loved to be under the jet rather than having to hold it.

We stayed in this apartment for a week at the end of our stay in Istanbul and it was perfect for our needs. Very comfortable and private, with a nice big bathroom/shower and spotlessly clean. The little kitchen is basic but all you need as there is so many restaurants and street vendors nearby. The location is perfect - just a short walk to Taksim but in a peaceful more local feeling street. There’s also an amazing Sunday market just around the corner with lots of local produce etc (local, not touristy at all).
The host is incredibly responsive to any issues. I’d recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul.

Place was spotless clean, equipped with everything necessary. Location is really great and close to city center, Taksim, Galata etc in walking distance. Despite its location so close to the center, the place is quiet, with no bars or restaurants downstairs. The price is very adequate. I recommend this place and Mitras as a host.

The host was very communicative and reaponsive from the beginning to the end. The flat was exactly as represented, clean, and tidy. This accomodations has a great price for the value; Although the location may look a bit shady, it felt totally safe.

description: Our apartment is located on the 4th floor of an elegant apartment building with an elevator in Akaretler, the center of shopping and dining establishments in Beşiktaş, Istanbul's most central and exclusive district. Our apartment with a large balcony and an en-suite bathroom is inspired by Italian furniture. We would be happy to give you a wonderful holiday and rest in this apartment. The apartment is located in a family apartment building. We kindly ask our valued guests to be sensitive about loud noise at late hours. Thank you.

reviews.text: Sami's place was fantastic and a great base to explore Istanbul. The location is perfect. Sami place is exactly as listed and has everything needed for a great stay. Sami was very responsive and proactively checked in with us. He provided recommendations in the area. He was accommodating and a great host. We highly recommend Sami's place. Overall, Sami is one of the best hosts, we've stayed with.

The place was just look alike how he described it. Great location, close to many restaurants, and shops! Also, very easy to find, you can save a lot bc the location is great if you need to get a taxi to go around. Overall I will recommend this place.

Sami is a great host! He was super welcoming, easy to reach, and made sure we had everything we needed. The place is perfect for family gathering and the location is awesome, just a heads up that the street stays pretty busy and loud. We had a great time and would definitely recommend staying here!
Güzel daire, merkezi konum her yere ulaşabilir şekilde. Sami beyle de iletişim mükemmeldi teşekkür ederim.

The host was very nice and friendly. Really helpful with any questions you have.
The place was large and nice to stay in.
Close to supermarket and many restaurants.

description: We are happy to host you, our esteemed guests, in our facility serving in the Avcılar region. Our facility is open 24/7 and you can have the opportunity to stay at any time. We serve you with our prices suitable for every budget. Our check-in time is 11:00 a.m. and our check-out time is 12:00 p.m. You can inform us of your early check-in requests in advance. Extra charges are made for late check-out after 12:00 p.m.

reviews.text: Tam olarak fiyat performans mekanıydı.Bir otelde olması gereken her şey mevcuttu iletişimleri de gayet güzeldi.Yatak ve çarşaflara kirli diyemem ama yenilenmesi lazım.
Çalışanlar güler yüzlü ve yardımsever, temizlik konusunda biraz daha dikkatli olunabilir genel anlamda memnun kaldım tam bir fiyat performans hoteli.
I had a wonderful stay. The staff was exceptionally communicative and helpful, and the location was perfect for exploring the area. Highly recommend this hotel!
Easily accessed, just as described and comfortable
Cost effective

description: Enjoy a stylish experience at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text: The room is exactly as shown in photos. Clean and spacious enough. Very great location, super close to tram station, Karaköy and Galata port. Everything is in walking distance. There is no elevator and stairs are quite small so bear in mind if you have big luggage. Bathroom is rather small but clean. The host is super responsive, check-in was easy and smooth. It has been a great stay. Definitely recommend!

The host was responsive and check in was quiete easy. It has great locations and close to everywhere you can need. The heating was not enough for us. Ac and the little heater were not enough for cold winter days. Overall good stay
Excelent host , great location, neighbourhood is amazing lots of very nice pubs and restaurants, the rooms are very nice design cleans and comfortable i mess very happy and can’t wait to be back .
Yunus Emre bey ile çok rahat iletişim kurduk. Eve giriş ve çıkış sorunsuz ve kolaydı. Evin konumu gayet merkezi ve güzel. Ev aynen fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi.

yunus was very helpful. when my wife was feeling cold, he went and bought a heater and brought it to our room. the major con for me was the shower was too small and the door was a bit broken so it was hard to take showers. also the steps going up are really small only half of my foot can fit on the steps which can be hard for big luggages. other than those, this place is really close to galata port so there is shopping and the train/tram is right there so you can easily get anywhere in the city. it’s a really nice place.
